item.title: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains.

Weight-normalized (WN) training is emerging as a compelling alternative to conventional weight decay (WD), with recent studies reporting substantial pretraining loss gains. We show that these gains are driven primarily by the induced effective learning rate (ELR) trajectory rather than by normalization alone. Matching ELR trajectories largely collapses the training loss dynamics of WN and WD. Schedule design should therefore target ELR rather than the nominal learning rate (LR) alone. Building on this principle, we propose AIR (Affine Inverse-square-Root decay), which combines a theoretically derived $1/\sqrt{t}$ decay with an affine adjustment to satisfy prescribed peak and terminal LRs over a finite training horizon. We further identify late-stage ELR scheduling as a key source of its gains, because a shared late schedule attenuates the effect of earlier LR choices. Experiments on 128 B-token Mixture-of-Experts pretraining demonstrate that AIR outperforms cosine and other candidate schedules in training loss, downstream performance, and hyperparameter robustness, reducing terminal training loss by approximately 0.01 relative to cosine at matched cumulative LR. item.title: Where Position Matters: Profiling-Guided Layer-Wise RoPE Allocation in Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RoPE 在各层通常统一覆盖，但层间位置需求异构且模型特定；固定预算下如何按层分配。 方法 profiling 引导的层间 RoPE 分配：用早期覆盖收益 profile 在固定预算下分配高/低覆盖；支持 MLA 的固定宽度表示与物理旋转维度分配；归一化深度映射让小模型测量指导大模型预训练前分配。 关键数字 从零训练实验在验证损失上优于匹配预算基线；解析核算表明物理 MLA 质量-存储-计算权衡更有利。 为什么值得看 把位置需求与可迁移架构设计相连，为 MLA 提供新设计维度。 阅读原文

item.title: When Does Heterogeneity Pay Off? Understanding GPU-WSE System Complementarity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU 与 WSE 在计算、内存、通信组织上差异大，异构集成何时能转化为实际性能收益尚不清楚。 方法 层次化基准方法刻画 GPU-WSE 异构执行与互补条件，配解析性能模型识别瓶颈与收益条件。 关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；提供判断异构是否值得的框架。 为什么值得看 异构加速器集成的系统化评估方法，架构选型期有参考价值。 阅读原文

item.title: Uncertainty-Guided Cross-Modal Alignment for Diffusion-Based IoT Intrusion Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models evolve noisy states toward a learned data distribution, so their sampling behavior depends on the geometry of the representation in which denoising occurs.

Diffusion models evolve noisy states toward a learned data distribution, so their sampling behavior depends on the geometry of the representation in which denoising occurs. This dependence is especially important for multimodal data: independently trained encoders can map synchronized views to incompatible latent regions, while uniform alignment can let an uncertain view distort the shared geometry. To address this gap, we introduce a novel reliability-guided alignment rule that uses normalized VAE posterior variance to control directional cross-modal influence before diffusion training. We study this issue in minority-attack generation for imbalanced Internet-of-Things intrusion detection. Tabular flow attributes, a DeepInsight image, and a packet sequence are encoded by modality-specific variational autoencoders. Per-modality normalized VAE posterior variances provide bounded, sample-specific weighting signals in an asymmetric stop-gradient alignment objective. We use these quantities as heuristic encoder-derived reliability proxies rather than calibrated probabilistic uncertainties. The full modality-specific latent means obtained after alignment fine-tuning are standardized and…

item.title: Turing LLM Post-Training: Calibrated Distillation and Efficient Dynamic-MoE Execution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 动态路由 MoE 后训练中如何整合各自独立优化的专家、同时保持整合高效。 方法 校准多教师 on-policy 蒸馏（局部 Top-K 匹配、损失归一化+裁剪），配合有界宽度分发、路由回放与异步 rollout-训练重叠。 关键数字 Turing-20B-A2B 四域归一化整合分 0.9988、每域保留 ≥90.16% 专家增益；8K 上限下数学/代码均分 85.92（Qwen3-8B 80.33）；整合步骤耗时 398.7→139.3 秒（2.86x）。 为什么值得看 专家整合与执行效率并重的完整后训练框架，数据扎实。 阅读原文

item.title: Topology Survives Shuffling: Robust Long-Context Memory Access Prediction for Graph Analytics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Graph analytics generates irregular, topology-dependent memory-access streams via indirect traversals, limiting data prefetching.

Graph analytics generates irregular, topology-dependent memory-access streams via indirect traversals, limiting data prefetching. Accurate prediction enables timely prefetches that hide memory latency. However, ML predictors couple short histories with fixed horizons, fitting the training trace's node layout rather than learning transferable graph patterns. We propose LoCoMAP, a long-context representation-learning framework for memory-access prediction with independently controlled observation history and prediction horizon. We evaluate Connected Components (CC), PageRank (PR), and Single-Source Shortest Paths (SSSP) on six synthetic graph families, with Erdos-Renyi (ER) and Grid as random and deterministic controls. We test two interventions: same-family regeneration changes connectivity, while node shuffling disrupts layout but preserves connectivity. Across 18 graph-workload pairs, extending history from 8 to 128 accesses improves F1 by 7.8%, while extending prediction horizon from 8 to 512 improves F1 by 88.3%. For CC, regeneration is less disruptive than shuffling: without retraining, long context retains 95.4% of original F1 and outperforms short context in six families. Und…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $\Sigma = \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V

In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet division-normalised first-order optimizers stall above a critical exponent $s^\ast$. We trace this failure to a numerical precision wall. At the ground truth, the smallest non-gauge expected Hessian eigenvalue scales at leading order as $V^{-(s+1)}D^{-s}$. When this curvature drops below the effective denominator floor $ε_O$ of optimizer $O$, normalisation noise overwhelms rare-direction gradients, yielding the leading-order boundary $s^\ast_O(V, D) = [\log(1/ε_O) - \log V]/\log(VD) + δ_O$, where $δ_O$ is a metric-dependent detection lag. With $δ_{\mathrm{Adam}}$ calibrated on four configurations and frozen, this formula predicts Adam's onset within $0.45$ across all 16 cells of a held-out grid ($V \in \{64,128,256,512\} \times D \in \{4,8,16,32\}$), separates fixed-$VD$ pairs, and distinguishes denominator-precision walls from conditioning and sign-quantisation walls. The approximation fails at $D = 2$, reflects a fin…

item.title: TRACEs: Fine-Grained Embedded Provenance for Distributed Scientific Workflows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Large-scale scientific workflows run on distributed HPC resources, making it hard to explain how scientific data products are generated and why similar workflow executions can yield very different results.

Large-scale scientific workflows run on distributed HPC resources, making it hard to explain how scientific data products are generated and why similar workflow executions can yield very different results. Existing systems usually focus on either distributed workflow execution or provenance management and rarely treat fine-grained provenance as an intrinsic property of distributed scientific data artifacts. We present TRACEs (Traceable Runtime for Advanced Containerized Executions), a provenance architecture for distributed containerized scientific workflows that embeds data lineage and execution context directly in every generated data artifact. By decoupling provenance from workflow orchestration, TRACEs generalizes artifact-centric provenance from local container runs to distributed workflows while remaining compatible with existing workflow management systems. We evaluate TRACEs on a seven-stage E. coli variant-calling workflow distributed across multiple HPC nodes. Our results show 100% provenance completeness under distributed execution, about 59% less intermediate storage via sparse IMG containers, and runtime and zero-copy I/O throughput comparable to fixed-size SIF contain…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TACFormer: Transformer-Based Generative Model for Target-Conditioned De Novo PROTAC Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Targeted protein degradation (TPD) represents a fundamental shift in drug discovery, moving beyond traditional target inhibition toward the event-driven removal of disease-causing proteins.

Targeted protein degradation (TPD) represents a fundamental shift in drug discovery, moving beyond traditional target inhibition toward the event-driven removal of disease-causing proteins. A prominent strategy for TPD is the use of proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), heterobifunctional molecules that selectively route a protein of interest (POI) to the ubiquitin-proteasome system for degradation. While PROTAC design still relies heavily on trial-and-error synthesis and experimental testing, deep generative models offer a promising means to explore PROTAC chemical space in silico and generate novel molecules. However, many existing generative methods formulate PROTAC design primarily as a linker-generation problem, with POI-binding (warhead) and E3-ligase-binding components fixed in advance. This restricts exploration of the full PROTAC chemical space and often leaves the POI implicit through the predefined warhead, rather than using protein-level information as an explicit conditioning signal during generation. To address these limitations, we propose TACFormer: a transformer-based generative model for target-aware de novo PROTAC design. The model conditions a GPT-style mole…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable.

Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitim…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sparse Fine-Tuning for Parameter-Efficient Adversarial Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations.

Deep neural networks achieve strong performance across many tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Adversarial training (AT) is one of the most effective defenses, yet it suffers from high memory cost on large models and the persistent clean-robust accuracy trade-off. Recent work introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning, such as LoRA, into AT, but this constraint induces a notable robustness gap relative to full-parameter AT. In this work, we revisit parameter-efficient adversarial fine-tuning from a parameter space perspective. Through gradient analysis, we find that adversarial optimization is highly concentrated on a small subset of parameters, which we call Robustness-Critical Parameters (RCPs), suggesting that robustness is encoded in a sparse subspace. Building on this observation, we propose Sparse Adversarial Fine-Tuning (SAFT), which identifies RCPs via adversarial gradient saliency and performs AT by updating only these parameters while freezing the rest. Across architectures and datasets, SAFT outperforms LoRA-based methods in both clean and robust accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, and approaches or surpasses full parameter AT in robustness w…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sparse Autoencoders as Implicit Diversification Regularisers for Cross-Sectional Cryptocurrency Returns
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Factor models are central to asset pricing and portfolio construction, but neural factors are often difficult to interpret, and their effect on portfolio risk is unclear.

Factor models are central to asset pricing and portfolio construction, but neural factors are often difficult to interpret, and their effect on portfolio risk is unclear. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) may address both concerns by describing daily returns across many assets with only a few active features. We ask whether this sparse representation produces stable financial factors and better-diversified portfolios. We study cryptocurrency returns, use equities as a secondary test, and compare the SAE with common benchmarks in a time-ordered evaluation. We find consistently lower volatility in SAE portfolios and link this result to lower correlations among the selected assets. However, the SAE does not outperform a simple contrarian strategy on risk-adjusted return, and its factor identities are not stable across training runs. Our contribution is to show that sparse coding can support portfolio diversification, while clearly separating this risk effect from claims about alpha or stable factor identities.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Softmax Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models: Collapse and Recovery
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts, suppressing access to the others.

Softmax routing in mixture-of-experts models can concentrate probability on a subset of experts, suppressing access to the others. We study how this concentration forms, why it persists, and how suppressed probabilities recover. For fixed experts, a stationary-loss barrier identifies the face supporting the optimal routed output. In a common-target square-loss model with freely trainable expert outputs, slow adaptation tracks fixed-expert dynamics on finite horizons, while every fixed positive adaptation rate yields an interior routing limit. An exact normal-velocity decomposition separates complementary-expert covariance from relative gradient advantage. Under positive two-sided power bounds along recovery paths, uniform over initial masses, the resulting coefficient's order of vanishing gives logarithmic or power-law recovery times. Integrations of constructed fields reproduce these orders. An exact discrete log-odds identity relates neural updates to threshold crossing. In paired Transformer-MoE training, removing a class-conditional router-gradient contrast delays confirmed recovery and reduces accumulated log-odds on fixed tokens, both with and without capacity constraints.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sandman: Building and Operating Sandboxes for Agentic Reinforcement Learning on Shared Kubernetes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often requires repeated tool calls in task-specific environments.

Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often requires repeated tool calls in task-specific environments. A training job may create thousands of these environments in bursts while sharing a cluster with other jobs. We present Sandman, a sandbox service built and operated at Amazon for agent tool execution and evaluation. It serves multiple production agentic RL workloads on shared Kubernetes. A training framework supplies a task image and uses commands and file operations in the returned sandbox. Files and processes persist across calls until the framework releases the environment. Sandman manages creation, readiness and cleanup. Each sandbox is a Kubernetes pod with a small daemon mounted into the unmodified image. In a scale test, Sandman held 11,858 concurrent tiny sandboxes. Four production SWE-bench Verified training campaigns created 3.1 million sandboxes in October 2026. We report the design trade-offs and operational lessons from handling creation bursts, preparing task environments, reclaiming abandoned sandboxes, and running evaluation under controlled conditions. We will open-source Sandman's daemon, provider and pool.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SPECTRUM: A Strategic Framework and Technical Blueprint for European Exascale Research Data and Compute Infrastructure
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

The HiLumi LHC, the SKA Observatory and LOFAR 2.0 will take High Energy Physics (HEP) and Radio Astronomy (RA) towards exabyte-scale data within the next decade, beyond the capacity of today's infrastructure.

The HiLumi LHC, the SKA Observatory and LOFAR 2.0 will take High Energy Physics (HEP) and Radio Astronomy (RA) towards exabyte-scale data within the next decade, beyond the capacity of today's infrastructure. The SPECTRUM project responded with two documents built on the same evidence. A Technical Blueprint describes a European compute and data continuum as a capability map, consolidates the gaps found in HEP, RA and related use cases, and recommends technical actions in eight areas. A Strategic Research, Innovation and Deployment Agenda (SRIDA) organises thirteen priorities in four pillars, maps them to investment areas and European funding instruments, and phases them over a roadmap set against the timelines of the three instruments. This paper, by editors and contributors of both documents, summarises them, their consultative method and the impact the SRIDA expects.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SHPRR: An Algorithm for Pure Exploration under Constrained Regret
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Best Arm Identification (BAI) conventionally measures the cost of experimentation by the number of samples collected.

Best Arm Identification (BAI) conventionally measures the cost of experimentation by the number of samples collected. In many operational settings, however, the cost of exploration relative to a trusted baseline already in place is equally important. We study BAI under both a fixed sampling horizon and a regret budget. Unlike generic resources considered in constrained pure exploration, regret has a distinctive structure: sampling better arms is less costly relative to the baseline. We theoretically show that the regret cost of exploration decreases across the phases of Sequential Halving, a widely used pure-exploration algorithm. This observation yields improved guarantees on the probability of identifying the best arm and motivates a more effective allocation of the regret budget. We propose Sequential Halving with Proportional Regret Rationing (SHPRR), which front-loads the regret budget to allow more exploration when many arms remain. Experiments on synthetic and real-world instances show that SHPRR improves best-arm identification performance over uniform regret allocation and existing baselines.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RetroChessBench: A Benchmark for Reconstructing and Proving Chess Histories
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities.

Frontier language models such as GPT 6 Astra have contributed to research mathematics, demonstrating substantial reasoning capabilities. Yet serious reasoning failures persist even in tasks governed by explicit rules. We demonstrate this in retrograde chess which is a playground for pure reasoning, where solvers reconstruct legal histories and distinguish possible events from forced ones. We introduce RetroChessBench, a 12-task benchmark covering exact-length constructions, unique endings, and exhaustive answer sets, with references, rubrics, and a terminal-reward environment. In two trials per task and condition, GPT 6 Astra High fails to produce the required final answer in 22/24 attempts without tools and 18/24 with code execution; mean terminal RL rewards are 14.75% and 27.19%, respectively. The examples identify faulty deductions: failed responses reject legal histories and treat temporary obstructions as permanent. Online retrograde archives often provide puzzles and final move sequences without detailed derivations. We hypothesize that limited exposure to these missing explanations in web-derived training data contributes to the observed reasoning failures. This questions ho…

Accurate land-cover mapping from multimodal Earth observation (EO) data remains a challenge in regions where high-resolution annotations are scarce or costly to obtain.

Accurate land-cover mapping from multimodal Earth observation (EO) data remains a challenge in regions where high-resolution annotations are scarce or costly to obtain. This work introduces a quantum convolutional encoder-decoder network for pseudo-label generation using Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery, guided only by coarse MODIS-derived land-cover maps. The proposed framework uses quantum-inspired convolutional blocks to enhance feature extraction and cross-sensor fusion, enabling the model to infer a fine-scale semantic structure from heterogeneous inputs. Experiments were conducted on the DFC2020 dataset, which provides a quadruple of Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 multispectral, low-resolution MODIS labels and high-resolution reference land-cover maps. The proposed training framework first learns a robust representation of multimodal inputs through the reconstruction branch before any supervision from low-resolution labels is applied. This self-supervised stage enables the model to capture a fine-scale spectral-spatial structure, which is then used to generate high-resolution pseudo-labels. item.title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch.

Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch. While unlearning requests happen continuously during a model's lifetime, the vast majority of LLM unlearning methods are ill-suited for iterated removal, yielding steep decay in forgetting and utility upon sequential unlearning. This decay stems from interference between successive updates, as each new deletion can undo earlier ones or push the model further along directions already degraded by them. To address this, we introduce Continual Orthogonal Projection (COP), a gradient-projection scheme that restricts each update to the orthogonal complement of activation subspaces cached from prior forget sets. This approach provably guarantees first-order non-interference with earlier deletions. COP stores only a low-rank basis per layer, requiring neither past gradients nor previous forget sets, and plugs into unlearning methods that update the model through gradient steps on a differentiable loss without modifying its objective. item.title: Possibility-based Inference: A Deterministic Framework for Robust and Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Decision-Making
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Decision-making under uncertainty remains a key issue in Machine Learning (ML), particularly in the deployment of safety-critical systems, where reliable quantification of system behavior is essential

Decision-making under uncertainty remains a key issue in Machine Learning (ML), particularly in the deployment of safety-critical systems, where reliable quantification of system behavior is essential for evaluating behavioral impacts and strengthening confidence in ML models. This contribution, influenced by fuzzy set theory and grounded in Bayesian statistics, addresses challenges related to data precision and the performance-accuracy trade-off in Bayesian inference (BI). To this end, we introduce a possibility-based contrastive grade of prediction as an alternative quantification method to existing latent posterior-based approaches for parameter estimation (approximation) and model selection. Unlike conventional Bayesian inference, which represents uncertainty within the probabilistic framework, the proposed model adopts a possibility-based representation that allows uncertain and potentially conflicting information to be characterized more flexibly. Rather than focusing on isolated aspects of a problem, the resulting mathematical framework provides a systematic approach to data mining while mitigating overly confident, yet implausible predictions generated by highly specialized…

研究问题 投机解码常被宣传省能耗，但省多少取决于被接受草稿 token 数，一直难以量化。 方法 生产条件（SGLang、CUDA graphs）下 H100/H200 实测，batch 最大 64、5 语料库，区分验证与起草环节能耗。 关键数字 密集模型验证主导能耗；batch 增大节能收缩，大 batch 下 block 草稿器节能变亏损，低接受率抬升每 token 能耗；对话接受率低于代码，Romansh 低于英语。 为什么值得看 首次算清投机解码能耗账，大 batch 下投机反而费电，集群能效规划受益。 阅读原文

item.title: One Vector or Many? Clustered Optimal-Transport Steering under Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time.

Activation steering changes what a language model generates by editing its hidden states at inference time. Its most common form adds one vector, the difference of class means (DiM), to every hidden state. CHaRS (concept heterogeneity-aware representation steering) uses optimal transport instead: an entropic plan pairs the clusters of the two classes, and each hidden state moves along a mixture of the cluster displacements, weighted toward its nearest clusters. We study this family of clustered optimal-transport maps for toxicity mitigation in Gemma-2-2B and Granite-3.1-2B, and ask what the plan adds to DiM and whether that survives INT8 and NF4 quantization. We prove an identity: whatever the plan, the displacements averaged with the cluster sizes as weights equal DiM, so a clustered map can differ from DiM only for tokens whose routing weights depart from the cluster sizes. In the CHaRS protocol they stay close, and CHaRS is statistically equivalent to Mean-AcT, which adds DiM at every layer, in all eight pre-specified equivalence tests. A variant fitted on individual tokens, which routes each token mainly to its nearest clusters, leaves 37-39% less toxicity than DiM on Gemma and…

item.title: Observability-Aligned Evidential Masked Pretraining for Reliable VRU Motion Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Vulnerable road user (VRU) prediction must operate under partial observability and distribution shift, so reliable uncertainty matters alongside accuracy.

Vulnerable road user (VRU) prediction must operate under partial observability and distribution shift, so reliable uncertainty matters alongside accuracy. Masked pretraining is attractive in this setting because it naturally exposes the model to missing content during self-supervision, but existing time-series masked autoencoding methods are typically deterministic and do not constrain how confidence should change with observability. We introduce eCoMAE, an evidential masked pretraining method for multivariate time series that explicitly aligns predictive evidence with what is observed. eCoMAE combines block-wise time-step masking with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma decoder and three observability-aware mechanisms: uncertainty-weighted mean consistency on positions visible in both a masked view and a reference pass, evidence suppression on masked positions, and representation consistency across stochastic masks. On IMPTC benchmark for VRU intention prediction under leave-one-environment-out weather shift, eCoMAE improves the strongest baseline from 0.7971 to 0.8068 in OOD accuracy and from 0.0718 to 0.0648 in OOD AURC. Additional evaluation on pedestrian trajectory forecasting across IMPTC…

item.title: OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration.

Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlist…

item.title: Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains.

We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$. Standard Quasi-Monte Carlo does not adapt its evaluation points to the integrand, while effective importance sampling requires a proposal that captures its concentration. Learned diffusion samplers can supply such a proposal, but existing methods are formulated on $\mathbb R^d$ and do not respect the domain constraint $x\in D$. We instead build the proposal from reflected dynamics that stay in $D$ by construction. A reflected diffusion progressively transforms the target distribution toward the uniform distribution on $D$, and a neural score model is trained to reverse this process. A change-of-measure formula for reflected diffusions yields a training objective without additional boundary terms and an unbiased importance-sampling estimator of $Z$. For non-smooth integrands, where reparameterization gradients may be undefined or uninformative, we derive a REINFORCE estimator of the training gradient using Gaussian proposal densities before reflection, without evaluating reflected transition densities or d…

item.title: Nearly-Optimal Time-Sample Trade-off in Consensus Dynamics
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

How does the number of sampled opinions affect the time required to reach consensus in distributed consensus dynamics?

How does the number of sampled opinions affect the time required to reach consensus in distributed consensus dynamics? We study the synchronous $h$-\textsf{Majority}, in which every node independently samples $h$ nodes uniformly at random with replacement in each round and adopts a most frequent sampled opinion, breaking ties uniformly at random. We show that $h$-\textsf{Majority} achieves the nearly-optimal trade-off between the sample size and the consensus time, among a broad class of consensus dynamics. In particular, we prove the following results. For every sample size $h \ge 3$ and for every initial configuration, we prove that the process reaches consensus with high probability within $\widetilde{O}\left(1+\min\left\{\frac{1}{\min\{h^2p_{\max},1\}},\frac{\sqrt{n}}{h}\right\}\right)$ rounds, where $n$ is the number of nodes and $p_{\max}$ is the largest initial fraction of nodes supporting any single opinion. This is the first bound on the consensus time for $h$-\textsf{Majority} that holds for every $h\ge3$ and every initial configuration. When the initially most popular opinion has a sufficiently large lead over every other opinion, we show that all nodes adopt this opinio…

item.title: NORmal: Architecting 3D Ferroelectric NOR Flash as Main Memory -- From Co-Fabricated BEOL Arrays to 200B-Class Multi-Agent LLMs in a Smartphone
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 智能手机上的 agent 团队（大 planner 指挥并行 worker 长会话）需要 200B 级模型和远超手机 DRAM 的上下文；现有方案把 flash 当存储：UFS 饿死按 token 权重流式，移动 HBF 需重设计 SoC 且无法吸收持续 KV 写。

方法 NORmal：首个面向 3D 铁电 NOR flash 的主存架构。共制造并实测 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列（密集 3-bit MLC + 快速高耐久 SLC，传感低于 7.5ns），经阵列下 DRAM 仿真桥接入未修改的 LPDDR6 总线成为字节可寻址 load/store rank；按可变性与寿命而非热度放置 agent 状态，动态跨 agent 阶段划分子通道。

关键数字 生产 agent trace 服务级仿真中，较 UFS 卸载快 8.9–28.0×，距无限 DRAM 理想仅差 0.4%；256K token 以上会话较 HBF 快 2.8–6.3×，每 token 内存能耗低 8.1–17.8×。

为什么值得看 用铁电 NOR 做主存支撑手机端 200B 级多 agent LLM，硬件实测+仿真数字惊艳，端侧大模型方向值得关注。

item.title: Multi-output LSTM soft sensors for industrial anaerobic co-digestion using LSTM-beta-VAE generative data augmentation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Anaerobic digestion (AD) requires close monitoring of key process variables, including pH, the ratio of volatile organic acids to alkaline buffer capacity and biogas production, to maintain biological stability and prevent process failure.

Anaerobic digestion (AD) requires close monitoring of key process variables, including pH, the ratio of volatile organic acids to alkaline buffer capacity and biogas production, to maintain biological stability and prevent process failure. While mechanistic frameworks such as the Anaerobic Digestion Model No. 1 are highly parameterised, computationally expensive, and difficult to calibrate for real-time applications, data-driven Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks offer a potentially more adaptable alternative. However, current data-driven approaches in AD are predominantly limited to single-output architectures that focus solely on production yields, as opposed to simultaneous prediction of vital stability indicators. Furthermore, industrial AD datasets are typically sparse and skewed toward steady-state operations. Baseline evaluations demonstrated this scarcity prevents standard algorithms (Random Forest, XGBoost) and unaugmented LSTMs from recognising the transition to unstable operations, resulting in poor estimation of stability indicators. To overcome these challenges, this study proposes a novel generative data augmentation framework using an LSTM-beta-Variational Autoen…

item.title: Multi-Solution Inverse Design of Pixelated Patch Antennas Using an Autoregressive Transformer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Deep-learning-based inverse design has emerged as a promising framework for pixelated patch antenna synthesis by enabling broader exploration of discrete geometry spaces and reducing design time compared with conventional template-based methods.

Deep-learning-based inverse design has emerged as a promising framework for pixelated patch antenna synthesis by enabling broader exploration of discrete geometry spaces and reducing design time compared with conventional template-based methods. Existing methods, including surrogate-assisted metaheuristic optimization, tandem inverse networks, and diffusion models, have advanced the field but still face practical limitations. Metaheuristic methods such as binary particle swarm optimization (BPSO) are sensitive to initialization and search hyperparameters and are often time-consuming, tandem networks have difficulty capturing the one-to-many nature of inverse antenna design, and diffusion models may require excessive complexity and data for moderate-scale binary layout synthesis. In this paper, an autoregressive (AR) transformer is presented for the inverse design of 10 x 10 pixelated patch antennas. Its sequential discrete generation process enables the synthesis of multiple feasible structures for a given target response. The pretrained model is further fine-tuned for dual-band design using step-shaped target responses with sharp spectral transitions, allowing intuitive band speci…

item.title: MulClip: A table-free activation function with monotonic and folding regimes for reservoir computing on microcontrollers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 微控制器（MCU）上环状储备池（ring reservoir）计算中，tanh 求值占状态更新时间高达 75%，需要更轻量的激活函数。

方法 MulClip：仅用比较、绝对值、乘法与减法实现曲率的轻量激活；裁剪阈值不放在极值点而是放在响应过极值后回到零点处，使单一函数兼具单调区与可增加单单元表达力的非单调折叠区；工作区由常规超参搜索决定，无需任务特定调阈。

关键数字 Cortex-M4 上实测状态更新时间为 tanh 的 0.34 倍，短于 11 种评估的 tanh 近似；PC 评估中三阶 MulClip 在 NARMA-20 上 NMSE 较 tanh 低 22%，8-bit parity 精度从单调裁剪变体的 0.76–0.78 提到 0.97–0.98；两类任务设备端推理与 PC 几乎一致。

为什么值得看 面向 MCU 储备池计算的无查表激活函数，硬件实测数字扎实，对超低功耗端侧 AI 有直接参考价值。

item.title: More Is Better? Exploring Latent Correspondence in Federated Hypergraph Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Federated hypergraph learning with latent cross-client hyperedge correspondence poses fundamental identifiability and computational challenges, as the same local release can correspond to multiple global hypergraph structures.

Federated hypergraph learning with latent cross-client hyperedge correspondence poses fundamental identifiability and computational challenges, as the same local release can correspond to multiple global hypergraph structures. We characterize the tractability of recovering these latent correspondences, showing tractable pairwise assignment but generally intractable multi-client hyperedge matching. Building on this characterization, we derive a cross-entropy decomposition that reveals when local prediction can outperform predictors fitted with additional cross-client information. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Federated Adaptive Spectral Training with Representation Alignment (FedASTRA), which learns correspondence-invariant diffusion representations through adaptive heat diffusion and masked latent prediction while communicating model parameters only. We establish its asymptotic optimality with respect to the permitted local information and prove global population-risk convergence under explicit conditions on recovery, representation, and update alignment. Experiments on eight real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedASTRA against identifier-free federated…

Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026). This growth has coincided with increased social-engineering fraud over Short Message Service (SMS) and Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD), where fraudsters impersonate network operators, agents, relatives, or regulators to obtain personal identification numbers (PINs), identity data, or funds. We present a supervised machine-learning pipeline for classifying scam and legitimate Ghanaian MoMo SMS messages using a labelled corpus of 220 messages across 18 scam and legitimate subcategories. Domain-specific normalisation of currency amounts, phone numbers, and USSD codes preceded TF-IDF vectorisation of unigrams and bigrams. Using stratified five-fold cross-validation and a 20% held-out test set, we trained and evaluated Multinomial Naive Bayes, linear support vector machine (SVM), and Random Forest classifiers using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). item.title: MRUD: Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit Number Systems for High-Performance Arithmetic Units
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits.

Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits. While Unsigned Digit Redundant (UDR) systems have shown promise in radix-2, their extension to higher radices remains unexplored. This work presents the first generalized Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit (MRUD) number systems for high-radix arithmetic, extending UDR representations from radix-2 to radix-$2^h$ while preserving carry-free addition. The proposed framework includes digit encoding, digit extension, arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, and multiplication), sign inversion, forward/reverse conversion algorithms, overflow/underflow detection, and hardware architectures for both signed and unsigned MRUD representations. Unlike MRSD, which is inherently limited to signed arithmetic, MRUD supports both signed and unsigned representations, similar to conventional binary systems. Evaluations across three multiplier modes---RRR (Redundant inputs, Redundant output), BBR (Binary inputs, Redundant output), and BBB (Binary inputs, Binary output)---as well…

item.title: Low-Bit GDN Recurrent-State Quantization: Global Gradient-aware Allocation and Pure-Write Sliding Windows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 线性注意力把历史信息存在固定大小循环状态中，降低状态精度会减少每请求存储，但量化写回误差进入后续递归、损害长推理质量，还伴随重复生成与过长输出。

方法 提出全局梯度感知分配（GGA）与纯写滑窗（PW）：GGA 结合候选量化残差与对未来预测损失的梯度敏感度，在模型级混合精度预算下分配各头位宽；PW 以 FP8 向量对独立维护近期纯写、经完整 GDN 状态转移传播、离开窗口后才并入低比特历史状态。

关键数字 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 七项评估上，GGA 单独较 STEPQuant@4 提升 19.48/29.84 个百分点；加 PW-S8 后七任务宏平均 69.83%/78.63%，较 STEPQuant@4 提升 38.39/41.21 个百分点；@6 时 GGA 把平均生成长度较 STEPQuant 降 10.45%/14.65%，GGA@4 加 PW-S8 再降 32.32%/36.77%。

为什么值得看 低比特循环状态量化的精度分配+近期信息维护双管齐下，长推理任务数据充分，对低比特线性注意力部署实用。

item.title: LinQuant: Functional Invariances for Low-Precision Linear Recurrences
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 线性递归正成为 softmax attention 的实用替代，但其低精度推理远不如 softmax attention 成熟——prefill 的 chunkwise 并行算法把大部分递归变成稠密矩阵乘，直接量化却可能很脆弱。

方法 识别保持全精度计算、同时让操作数更易量化的函数不变性，提出 LinQuant：基于旋转、对角重缩放、递归衰减与写因子重放置等七种不变性的低精度递归 prefill 框架；推导其在线性、门控、delta 规则等递归族中的有效性条件，并增强 SSDi8（Mamba-2 低精度 prefill 流水线）。

关键数字 在匹配延迟下改善 Mamba-2 1.3B/2.7B/8B 与 Nemotron-H 8B 的困惑度，证明基于不变性的量化对递归模型的实用价值。

为什么值得看 为线性注意力低精度推理提供系统的理论抓手，对递归/混合架构的量化和部署有直接帮助。

item.title: Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 AI 基础设施分层设计虽可管理，但固定了优化器能考虑的选择——需要芯片与软件协同改变才能获得的收益在优化开始前就被排除；LM agent 能否跨层制定优化问题？

方法 Formulaic 流程分工：agent 写公式化（problem formulation），数学求解器在其内优化，验证与测量检查假设与结果；agent 从计算图逐步向芯片细化问题，每步是带正确性条件的程序模板族；Wall relaxation 通过给约束软件的关键硬件限制定价来搜索芯片空间。

关键数字 NVIDIA GB10 上 agent 写的模板运行完整 Qwen3-8B 层较 SGLang 快 1.075×；模拟 Ventus GPU 上联合设计把 Qwen2.5-0.5B 最坏场景周期降至参考的 0.428（纯软件为 0.934）；五步 GEMM 精化链上复用证明使检查快 2.51×。

为什么值得看 把"跨层协同设计"从口号变成 agent+求解器+验证的分工流程，虽为分步研究，思路与数字都有参考价值。

item.title: Learning to Bound: Monotonic, Calibrated Neural Upper Bounds for MPE Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) compactly encode structured joint distributions, but Most Probable Explanation (MPE), which finds the highest-probability assignment to unobserved variables, rema

Probabilistic graphical models (PGMs) compactly encode structured joint distributions, but Most Probable Explanation (MPE), which finds the highest-probability assignment to unobserved variables, remains computationally intractable in large, densely structured models. Anytime systematic search, such as branch-and-bound (B&B), is a popular approach, but its efficiency depends on tight admissible upper bounds that are often prohibitively expensive to compute using classical methods like Mini-Bucket Elimination (MBE). We introduce Learning to Bound (L2B), a data-driven framework that amortizes bound computation cost by training a neural predictor. L2B targets two key properties required for effective search bounds: admissibility, which is achieved via statistical calibration techniques, and progressive tightening as evidence accumulates, which is enforced through structural architectural constraints that ensure monotonicity by construction. Across challenging benchmarks, L2B delivers tighter, monotonic bounds at orders-of-magnitude lower cost on every PGM family, and yields measurable improvements when integrated with branch-and-bound on high-treewidth instances.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: LatentWeave: Test-Time Latent Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters.

Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters. However, existing approaches primarily operate at the prompt or output level, leaving the latent reasoning process largely uncontrolled and insufficient to prevent error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address this limitation, we propose LatentWeave, a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory. LatentWeave performs structured Latent Weaving, progressively refining intermediate hidden states segment-wise to correct emerging deviations, and further introduces Reasoning Anchors via lightweight WEAVE tokens to stabilize reasoning structure and guide answer-oriented generation. These mechanisms are designed to enable fine-grained, step-aware intervention in the latent reasoning process while keeping the main MLLM backbone parameters fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks report improvements over the evaluated baselines; the contribution of latent optimization, anchor traini…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM agent 设计 CPU 时，长程 RTL 仿真动辄数小时，短诊断运行又可能漏掉后期才出现的性能劣化——评估成本拖累设计决策。

方法 开发 FPGA-in-the-Loop 开发环境：LLM agent 直接在 FPGA 上实现 CPU 候选，用板上性能计数器实时测量引导设计决策；人工监督下把单周期 RV32I 核演进为三宽乱序 RV32IM 核。

关键数字 最终设计在 Artix-7 FPGA 上 130 MHz 达 5.61 CoreMark/MHz；同一候选跑 8000 次 CoreMark 时，FPGA 评估（含实现）比单线程 RTL 仿真快 9.6×；板测还发现一个短诊断运行表现提升、长程却劣化的候选，引导了根因分析与修复。

为什么值得看 LLM 自动设计 CPU 的工程闭环范例，板上评估替代长仿真的思路对硬件自动化设计有直接价值。

item.title: LAMP: LLM-Driven Analog Placement through Adaptive Tool Composition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance.

Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance. Balancing these trade-offs through predefined objectives and fixed placement flows remains difficult. In this paper, we propose an analog placement framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as a layout engineer through composable placement components. These components support constraint management, placement and legalization, and lightweight evaluation of routability and electrical performance. Using multimodal checkpoints of the initial and evolving design, the LLM selects and combines components to construct and revise its own placement flow. It also adapts the placement hierarchy by reopening modules or partitioning and regrouping devices, allowing local layouts to respond to global design needs. An experience skill provides reusable design knowledge to guide these decisions. Evaluation on two SMIC 180 nm circuits shows that the framework reduces placement area and improves most measured post-layout performance metrics.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines.

Unsupervised environment design (UED) methods such as PLR, ACCEL, SFL and PAIRED are compared mostly on 2D mazes, grid worlds and BipedalWalker, while terrain curricula for legged robots are hand-designed and evaluated against a few baselines. We present a benchmark that runs fourteen UED, domain-randomisation and robotics curricula under one protocol on five 3D quadrupeds in MuJoCo MJX: the closed-chain W01-TEK and the open-chain Unitree Go1 and Go2, Google Barkour vB and Boston Dynamics Spot. Levels are vectors of eight interpretable terrain parameters, and all curricula drive the same PPO student at matched environment-step budgets. The evaluation reports success on random and held-out structured terrains, interquartile means with stratified bootstrap intervals, capability envelopes and a level-by-level domination comparison. We compare methods within each robot and report, per level set, the top group of methods not significantly below the best. No method is in the top group on every robot and level set. Methods with easy or low-difficulty training levels, curated or not, fill the top groups on in-distribution random levels of Go1 and Barkour, and of W01-TEK apart from PAIRED+B…

item.title: IMRouter: Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Accurate time series forecasting (TSF) is essential for Web applications, such as traffic monitoring and online resource management.

Accurate time series forecasting (TSF) is essential for Web applications, such as traffic monitoring and online resource management. Recent advances in leveraging pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have shown promising performance in TSF. However, existing LLM-based TSF methods largely optimize the overall forecasting objective while overlooking temporal pattern imbalance (TPI), where different temporal patterns occur at highly unequal frequencies. Our empirical analysis reveals that TPI is prevalent across widely used TSF benchmarks, with substantially higher forecasting errors on less frequent patterns. To address this issue, we propose IMRouter (Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing), a novel framework that mitigates TPI-induced biases in both temporal representation learning and cross-modal alignment. Specifically, IMRouter introduces Pattern-Adaptive Temporal Representation Learning (PATR), which leverages gradient conflict and local gradient density to guide expert specialization. By penalizing incompatible expert assignments with density-aware weighting, PATR reduces the dominance of frequent optimization signals in router training. Furthermore, Routing-Guided Seman…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting.

This work develops a physics-informed multimodal deep learning framework for 10- to 110-minute-ahead probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting. The forecasting model is built on a four-branch architecture that separately encodes plant-level temporal history and inverter-level spatial cloud dynamics through a graph attention encoder with a learned adjacency, known-future solar geometry, and the current meteorological state, fused through gated cross-attention. The geometry branch adds two forward-looking physical signals, spatial cloud heterogeneity and inverter ramp-down activity, each empirically weighted toward the horizon where it is most predictive. The decoder anchors its prediction to a smart persistence baseline, learning a horizon-conditioned correction, and the resulting quantile forecasts are calibrated online through a kernel-weighted adaptive conformal calibration step. The proposed model outperforms all 14 baselines, achieving a forecast skill score (FSS) of 0.2950, 0.099 above the next-best model. item.title: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 Transformer 通过重复应用同一 transformer（或其部分）在不增参数下加深模型——是否有用取决于模型大小、训练算力还是自回归推理效率哪个约束主导？

方法 从头训练稠密 decoder-only transformer，系统变化"循环哪些部分、循环次数、循环间信息传递方式"；实验覆盖至 1B 参数、155B token、1.07×10²¹ FLOPs、32 次循环。

关键数字 固定参数预算下循环整个 transformer 质量最强；训练 FLOPs 受限时循环中间块收益更好；循环增益会饱和、反转甚至不稳定；循环数增加带来正比的解码减速；并行循环（Parallel Loop Transformers）通过跨 token 位置传隐状态并发各循环阶段，保留当前 token 嵌入并分别归一化可恢复强性能。

为什么值得看 对"循环是否值得"给出跨三约束的系统结论，把设计选择与资源约束对应起来，训练与推理两端都有指导意义。

item.title: How Far Are We From On-Device VLM Inference? A Measurement Study on Edge NPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 端侧 VLM 在边缘 NPU 上部署的跨层协同（架构/runtime/硬件）仍少被探索——离端侧 VLM 推理落地还有多远？

方法 实证测量：6 个代表性 VLM × 3 个真实边缘平台 × 10 个多模态基准，从端到端应用延迟与热迹钻到低层 kernel 级执行行为。

关键数字 三个反直觉发现：① softmax 主导注意力开销，查表式优化也消除不了使 NPU 矩阵单元严重空转的流水气泡；② 线性注意力的理论加速在真实 NPU 上因张量重排开销消失；③ 无硬件后端在自回归解码上全面占优，注意力张量形状的并行度决定 NPU 效率并改变 CPU-NPU 性能平衡。

为什么值得看 系统量化端侧 VLM 推理的真实差距，对硬件架构师、runtime 开发与模型设计者都给出跨层建议。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval.

Deep search agents extend language models by interleaving reasoning with external retrieval. However, effective search-agent training requires addressing two challenges beyond final-answer optimization. First, the capability frontier of agents is largely determined by training questions, whereas fixed or labeled task collections cannot adapt as agents improve. Second, outcome-only reinforcement learning treats all successful trajectories equally, even when some correct answers rely on redundant searches, creating an inherent tension between answer accuracy and tool efficiency. To address these issues, we introduce \textsc{ZEST-Search}, a zero-label and tool-efficient framework for search-agent training via heterogeneous co-evolution. Starting from unlabeled reference questions, \textsc{ZEST-Search} constructs validated search tasks online through an answer-first and evidence-path-guided generation process. A heterogeneous proposer adaptively constructs training tasks around the solver's evolving capability boundary, while the solver learns search-augmented reasoning through reinforcement learning. item.title: Going deep, reaching further: What can Boltzmann machines efficiently represent?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

While universal approximation theorems theoretically underpin the representation capabilities of machine learning models, they have two shortcomings: They do not focus on efficient representations and

While universal approximation theorems theoretically underpin the representation capabilities of machine learning models, they have two shortcomings: They do not focus on efficient representations and they tend to be insensitive to depth and other heuristically important properties. In this work we show that these two shortcomings are intertwined. We prove that machine learning models which are deeper or have higher-order interactions can efficiently represent a larger set of functions, i.e. have larger efficient reach. It follows that deep Boltzmann machines (DBMs) have maximal efficient reach, restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) sub-maximal, and k-body generalizations of RBMs form a hierarchy between the two, even though all are universal. More generally, (i) we provide a full characterization of machine learning models with maximal efficient reach; (ii) we derive separations between deep and shallow models for three representation tasks; and (iii) we prove that the efficient reach of shallow models constitutes an infinite hierarchy indexed by the interaction order. The proofs draw on different methodologies, namely on (i) a recent characterization of universal spin models; (ii)…

item.title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links.

Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. item.title: Factorized Representations of Concurrent Temporal Variables in Pretrained Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document.

Language models often need to maintain multiple contextual variables that evolve independently within a document. Prior work has identified structured representations of individual temporal or contextual quantities, but their joint organization remains less understood. We study this question using controlled documents with independently phased language-switch and topic-change timers. Across ten pretrained checkpoints, both timers are linearly decodable from the same hidden states. Removing a timer-associated centroid plane substantially reduces access to its associated variable while having little effect on the concurrent timer, although the planes are nonorthogonal and contain cross-timer information. Separate timer contributions also explain most reproducible variation among joint-state centroids. These signatures persist from 3 to 51 timer values and across Qwen3 checkpoints from 0.6B to 14B. Schedule position affects continuation probabilities, but the tested centroid displacement produces no consistent timer-specific output effect. Together, these results support approximate factorization based on selective accessibility and approximately additive joint-state geometry in overl…

item.title: Energy-Efficient Memristor Accelerator for Depression Detection with a CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference.

Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference. To address this challenge, we propose a unified resistive RAM (ReRAM) processing-in-memory accelerator for a CNN-LSTM attention workload. The architecture integrates convolutional, recurrent, attention, and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) stages within a crossbar-based framework, reducing intermediate data movement between spatial and temporal branches. CNN operations are mapped through im2col-based vectorization, while LSTM gate computations are reformulated using concatenated input-state vectors and mapped onto ReRAM crossbars. We further provide module-level workload breakdown, parameter sensitivity analysis, and matched-workload context against representative ReRAM/PIM accelerators. Experimental results show 32.1 times and 9.3 times latency reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, with about 160 times and 140 times energy reduction. Simplified weight-perturbation tests characterize ASLF sensitivity in an untrained pipeline with synthetic spectrogram-shaped inputs. Task-level predict…

item.title: Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of an End-to-End Cosine-Domain CNN Using High-Level Synthesis
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 传统 CNN 计算成本限制其在低功耗设备上的高速边缘 AI 部署，全谱域（复值）实现又带来复杂算术与层间逆变换开销。

方法 提出端到端余弦域 CNN（CD-CNN）：用实值 DCT 域表示做中间特征提取，避免复值算术与谱层间逆变换；在 Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P 上用 HLS 实现，与全谱域 FD-CNN 在一致约束下对比。

关键数字 MNIST 上能效 112.91 frames/J、94 类 ASCII 上 101.27 frames/J，分别较 FD-CNN 提升 1.51× 与 2.76×；较此前 GPU 版全谱 CD-CNN 能效提升 12.96×。

为什么值得看 实值 DCT 域做边缘 CNN 推理的完整 FPGA 实现，能效数据具体，对低功耗边缘 AI 硬件有参考价值。

发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 传统 CNN 计算成本限制其在低功耗设备上的高速边缘 AI 部署，全谱域（复值）实现又带来复杂算术与层间逆变换开销。

方法 提出端到端余弦域 CNN（CD-CNN）：用实值 DCT 域表示做中间特征提取，避免复值算术与谱层间逆变换；在 Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P 上用 HLS 实现，与全谱域 FD-CNN 在一致约束下对比。

关键数字 MNIST 上能效 112.91 frames/J、94 类 ASCII 上 101.27 frames/J，分别较 FD-CNN 提升 1.51× 与 2.76×；较此前 GPU 版全谱 CD-CNN 能效提升 12.96×。

为什么值得看 实值 DCT 域做边缘 CNN 推理的完整 FPGA 实现，能效数据具体，对低功耗边缘 AI 硬件有参考价值。

item.title: End-to-End Guarantees for Masked Diffusion Models under Conditional Mixing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Masked diffusion models train a denoiser on masked cross-entropy and generate by unmasking many positions in parallel.

Masked diffusion models train a denoiser on masked cross-entropy and generate by unmasking many positions in parallel. Existing MDM sampling bounds assume an exact denoiser or leave its error uncontrolled while training bounds cover only the masking distribution on which the model was trained. We present an end-to-end guarantee for a learned denoiser under conditional mixing (CM): stationary sources (e.g. floored order-$r$ Markov and two-sided-Doeblin hidden-Markov sources) for which revealing distant visible tokens moves a masked token's posterior on average exponentially little in the distance with correlation length $τ_c$. We show the empirical risk minimizer trained under any masking distribution attains per-token excess $\varepsilon'$ on that distribution from $\varepsilon'^{-\mathcal{O}(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)}$ training sequences, independent of sequence length $N$ -- one sample budget serves every decoding schedule when each schedule's denoiser is trained under its own weighting. We further show that the exponent's order $Θ(τ_c\log|\mathcal{V}|)$ is minimax-optimal up to constants; more efficient rates require added structure. item.title: Enabling Dynamic Resource Scaling in Quantum Circuit Simulations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Studies of quantum algorithms often simulate se- quences of circuits whose number of qubits changes from one circuit to the next, such as instances of increasing size of the same problem.

Studies of quantum algorithms often simulate se- quences of circuits whose number of qubits changes from one circuit to the next, such as instances of increasing size of the same problem. Since each additional qubit doubles the state- vector, every circuit needs a different number of nodes, which a fixed allocation on a shared High-Performance Computing (HPC) system cannot provide: a job sized for the largest circuit leaves most of its nodes idle, and one job per circuit adds scheduler interactions and queue waits. We make the QuEST state-vector simulator malleable with the Dynamic Management of Resources (DMR) framework, so that a single job resizes between circuits. Because no state-vector exists between circuits, reconfigurations require no data redistribution and no changes to the simulation kernels, and a checkpoint holding the index of the next circuit is enough to resume. A right-sizing policy derives the number of nodes from the number of qubits, and the circuit_executor API hides reconfigurations from the user. We evaluate the reconfiguration overhead on MareNostrum 5 and show that a single job can run a batch of circuits of different sizes, adapting its allocation to each…

item.title: DolphinRouting: Cluster-Level Binary Routing for Disaggregated LLM Inference Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 PD（prefill-decode）分离推理中，请求级路径选择需同时考虑 prefill 工作量、cache 复用与 decode 需求，如何自动学习？

方法 DolphinRouting：在给定 P/D 资源分配下从端到端 SLO 反馈学习决策——按原始 prompt 长度、两个 worker 池上 cache 调整后输入长度与输出长度信息聚类请求；离线策略搜索每簇学一个二元动作，在线查表选本地或远端 prefill。

关键数字 真实 PD 分离集群上，混合负载与真实数据下 k-means 版较 Dynamo 降 P90 TTFT 5.7–7.9%、P90 TPOT 2.6–10.1%。

为什么值得看 把路由决策学习化、按簇二值化，实测数据覆盖混合负载，对 PD 分离 serving 系统有直接参考价值。

item.title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference.

Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific in…

item.title: D-MOD: Diffusion mode estimation for accelerated MRI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models are powerful priors for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but most current methods are posterior samplers, which return a random draw from the posterior.

Diffusion models are powerful priors for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but most current methods are posterior samplers, which return a random draw from the posterior. A reproducible and high-quality reconstruction often requires averaging many samples, resulting in a high computational cost. We introduce D-MOD, a fast algorithm that instead provides a posterior mode. It uses a minorize-maximize algorithm on a lower bound of the smoothed log-posterior, which provably increases the objective. Each iteration draws S noisy samples of the current estimate at the current noise level, denoises them with a pretrained diffusion model, and combines their average with the measured k-space through a conjugate-gradient (CG) solve. We anneal the noise levels, as the distance between the bound and its target decays quadratically with noise. On fastMRI brain (T1, T2, FLAIR), a single D-MOD reconstruction exceeds, in PSNR, the 10-sample finite-MMSE estimates of DPS, DAPS and SNORE-P and stays within 0.31 dB of the strongest baselines (DiffPIR, DDS). This approach thus provides a fast deterministic reconstruction algorithm (11-73 times faster than MMSE estimates), which is useful in a clinical set…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: CovFedAvg: Local Low-Loss Curves and Federated Model Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Clients observing different parts of a prediction task may learn locally equivalent models with incompatible behavior outside their observed support.

Clients observing different parts of a prediction task may learn locally equivalent models with incompatible behavior outside their observed support. We study whether redundant models permit local low-loss paths toward a compatible shared model. CovFedAvg retains local models and curve controls on clients, fits a common endpoint through aggregated gradient contributions, and selects an actual candidate model using distributed training losses. No centralized calibration examples or client-to-client sample exchange are required. Exact selection guarantees no higher evaluated training loss than the previous model and the current-round FedAvg candidate; this is not a global-optimality, stationarity, generalization, or differential-privacy guarantee. We state conditional client-compatibility and approximate-selection bounds and retain corrected transformation identities and a separate full-gradient safeguard theorem for reference algorithms. A complementary input-support example recovers the shared absolute-value regression, while matched direct fine-tuning also solves it. Across a synthetic support task, recorded activity-recognition subjects, and participating and future gas-sensor ba…

item.title: Composing and Steering Diffusion Models with Generalized Feynman-Kac Correctors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead d

Diffusion models have become the leading paradigm in generative modeling, yet many applications require sampling from distributions that are not those of any single pretrained model, but are instead defined through combinations of several models, possibly tilted toward high values of a downstream reward. Naively combining the scores of the models yields incorrect samples, while existing corrections are restricted to specific families of targets. In this work, we introduce the generalized Feynman-Kac correctors (GFKC), a principled framework for sampling from an arbitrary target function of several pretrained diffusion models. We show that the geometric interpolation between an arbitrary initial function and the target function of the models satisfies a Feynman--Kac partial differential equation, and derive its potential in closed form. To evaluate this potential during generation, we further generalize the log-probability ODE to track the density of each model along trajectories driven by a different velocity field. The resulting algorithm operates entirely in the log domain, incorporates reward-based steering at no additional conceptual cost, and corrects the generation on the fly…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR): Class Incremental Hazard Diagnosis for Resilient AI in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems provide critical computation services in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet (MII), and their resilience depends on timely diagnosis of hazards across the data, AI pipeline, and cyber-physical layers.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems provide critical computation services in the Manufacturing Industrial Internet (MII), and their resilience depends on timely diagnosis of hazards across the data, AI pipeline, and cyber-physical layers. During operation, new hazard types keep emerging with only a few samples each, hazards co-occur, and the diagnosis model runs on memory-constrained computation nodes. Replay-based class-incremental learning (CIL) can learn new hazard classes while revisiting a small memory of past samples, but existing methods assume single-label, balanced streams, store high-dimensional raw samples, and select them independently of the classifier. We propose Class-aware Latent Attention Replay (CLAR), which combines a dual buffer that stores mostly compact latent representations with a few raw samples, an Attention Leverage Score (ALS) that upper-bounds the classifier logit and guides class-balanced reservoir sampling, and an exponential-moving-average teacher that slows latent-space drift. item.title: Can We Rely on Language Models to Orchestrate Services across the Edge-Cloud Continuum?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘-云连续体上越来越多用 LM 做服务编排（调度/配置/诊断/修复），但"输出有用"不等于"编排可靠"——可靠性取决于 LM 进入决策的位置、授权、约束与系统级证据。

方法 系统综述 39 项主研究，提出五维分析框架：系统上下文、编排决策、LM 自主性、运维防护、评估证据；梳理 LM 责任与下游保底组件分工。

关键数字 综述覆盖 39 项主研究；发现主要是混合设计——LM 承担解释、候选生成与缓解规划，可行性强制与执行权多留在下游组件；有界闭环修复初现，但跨异构环境的生产级证据仍有限。

为什么值得看 对"能否把服务编排交给 LLM"给出结构化的证据盘点，适合评估 LLM agent 在运维场景的边界。

item.title: Caerus: Prefetching by Thinking Globally and Acting Locally
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 偏移预取器（offset prefetcher）在全局与局部偏移提取间两难：BOP 选单一全局偏移但缺乏上下文敏感精度跟踪，Berti 用 PC 局部提取却抓不住全局内存模式。

方法 Caerus：在多个不重叠的全局派生偏移上做 PC 局部过滤——从全局内存 trace 提取多个偏移，仅用未被先前学习偏移覆盖的访问训练每个偏移，最大化联合覆盖；各偏移精度按 PC 跟踪。

关键数字 SPECspeed 2017 上几何平均提速 8.3%，超过 Berti 2.0%，硬件与 DRAM 流量开销低。

为什么值得看 融合全局模式与 PC 局部精度的预取设计，简单思路显著胜出 SOTA，对存储层次优化有启发。

关键数字 SPECspeed 2017 上几何平均提速 8.3%，超过 Berti 2.0%，硬件与 DRAM 流量开销低。

为什么值得看 融合全局模式与 PC 局部精度的预取设计，简单思路显著胜出 SOTA，对存储层次优化有启发。

item.title: Attention, Dynamic Wave and Hybrid Sequence Mixers in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on Multi-Head Attention (MHA) for sequence modeling, but scaling to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of attention, motivating sub-quadratic recurrent alternatives.

Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on Multi-Head Attention (MHA) for sequence modeling, but scaling to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of attention, motivating sub-quadratic recurrent alternatives. This paper formalizes a Dynamic Wave recurrent layer, based on input-dependent exponential damping and cosine phase modulation, and evaluates three 10.94M-parameter configurations (Pure Transformer, Pure Wave, and Hybrid Wave-Attention) on TinyStories under perplexity, latency, throughput and peak VRAM profiling up to 4096 tokens. The Hybrid configuration reaches the best perplexity, 5.95 on the full held-out split against 6.93 for the Transformer and 7.26 for Pure Wave. The efficiency picture, however, is governed by implementation rather than by architecture. Against an unfused attention baseline, Pure Wave uses 78.7% less peak VRAM at a 4096-token context (1404.3 MB vs. 6601.6 MB); against a fused scaled-dot-product attention kernel the same comparison yields no advantage at all (1404.3 MB vs. 1403.6 MB), and in training mode Pure Wave is 8.3% more expensive than the Transformer. Likewise, hoisting elementwise terms out of the recurrence loop speeds the layer up 2.53…

item.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation.

The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation. In this paper we address the question whether an analogous formulation exists for discrete diffusion models and answer it affirmatively by introducing exponential residual flows (ERFs). Our framework augments the discrete state with a continuous residual variable for each token and position. These residuals evolve deterministically according to piecewise-defined ODEs whose vector fields depend on the current discrete state and the forward and backward rate matrices of the prescribed diffusion model. The discrete state changes whenever a residual reaches zero. We prove that this construction preserves the marginals of the original diffusion. We derive a practical discretization of our sampler and specialize it to masked and uniform diffusion. The deterministic trajectories of ERFs support consistency distillation and yield empirical improvements over previous approaches across a variety of benchmarks including code and text generation tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: An Exact Parallel Dense Gauss-Seidel Algorithm with Trade-Offs between Parallel Execution Time and Preprocessing Time
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

The Gauss-Seidel iterative method is commonly used for solving systems of linear equations because of its good convergence properties.

The Gauss-Seidel iterative method is commonly used for solving systems of linear equations because of its good convergence properties. However, the Gauss-Seidel algorithm cannot be easily parallelized because of the data dependencies existing at each iteration. The best parallel execution time for dense systems of equations is $O(n)$ given that enough processors are available and no preprocessing is performed. In this paper we propose a new parallel Gauss-Seidel algorithm which is capable of achieving better parallel runtimes at the expense of more preprocessing time. The algorithm can be tuned in order to provide convenient trade-offs between the preprocessing time and the best parallel runtime achievable by the algorithm.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
