item.title: APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance.

Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance. Placement is especially critical among the layout stages, as it constrains the routing solution space and the achievable post-layout performance. Existing analytical placement methods optimize device coordinates under center-based wirelength proxies and leave access point (AP) selection to routing. In analog circuits, however, a routing pin is an extended piece of terminal metal rather than a fixed point, and the best AP on it depends on where the other connected devices are placed, so a coordinate-only placement optimizes for connection points that the router will not use. We present APPlace, a routing-aware analog placement framework that co-optimizes device locations and AP selections during global placement, followed by a legalization stage that preserves the structure established by global placement. Experimental results on four real-world analog benchmarks show that APPlace achieves better overall post-layout performance than representative baselines at comparable layout area. item.title: AI in the EGI e-infrastructure -- Past experiences and future strategies
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

The EGI Federation has provided federated e-infrastructure services to European and global science for over 15 years.

The EGI Federation has provided federated e-infrastructure services to European and global science for over 15 years. We review EGI's early experiences with AI in the interTwin and iMagine Horizon Europe projects, which built digital twins in physics and environmental sciences and an image-analysis platform for aquatic research. We then examine how the AI landscape has changed since 2023 and argue that the focus of AI in science has shifted from model training to adapting and applying AI to specific domains, projects and questions. Building on these lessons, we present the AI strategy emerging from the EGI Federation Strategy 2026-2030, organised around three enablers: (1) an AI-ready infrastructure connecting compute, data and application resources across the continuum; (2) human skills to know what is possible with AI and how to implement it; and (3) trust, to run AI with confidence even in high-risk environments. We describe the projects implementing each enabler, including federated LLM inference, AI-ready data platforms and AI competence centres, and discuss a division of labour with EuroHPC's AI Factories, RAISE, research infrastructures and EOSC, in which EGI specialises in …

item.title: ACAM-J-MARS: Multi-Atlas Riemannian Spectral Representations for Decoding Advanced Meditation States from fMRI
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Inferring jhana-type advanced concentration absorption meditation (ACAM-J) states from fMRI data is challenging due to the spatially distributed nature of meditation-related effects, substantial inter

Inferring jhana-type advanced concentration absorption meditation (ACAM-J) states from fMRI data is challenging due to the spatially distributed nature of meditation-related effects, substantial inter-individual variability that can exceed within-subject state differences, and limited sample sizes. Conventional machine-learning approaches often formulate this problem as unimodal, Euclidean, atlas-based classification, thereby neglecting the non-Euclidean geometry of functional connectivity matrices and underrepresenting temporal information in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI); these limitations can lead to suboptimal classification performance. We propose ACAM-J-MARS (\textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}tlas \textbf{R}iemannian \textbf{S}pectral representation), which computes functional connectivity using multiple atlases, represents symmetric positive definite (SPD) connectivity matrices on a Riemannian manifold, projects them into a log-Euclidean tangent space, and augments connectivity-derived features with low-frequency BOLD spectral energy to better resolve subtle state differences under heterogeneous variability. Evaluated on 204 segments from 22 practitioners, ACAM-J-MARS …

item.title: A Unified Hessian-Guided Framework for Post-Training Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低比特量化部署 LLM 时，量化范围、线性变换、取整决策通常用局部重建目标独立优化，未考虑误差对下游预测的不同影响；任务级目标又因量化不连续而难以直接优化。

方法 推导联合权重+激活量化的输出变化 Hessian 引导近似，基于可解 Fisher 近似构建统一后训练量化框架，在共同输出敏感度目标下联合优化量化范围、线性变换与取整。

关键数字 摘要未给出统一数值；结论是在通道级与块级量化设置下一致优于 SOTA 变换与取整方法，且对现代 LLM 保持实用。

为什么值得看 把零散的后训练量化组件统一到单一敏感度目标，理论导出+实用兼顾，对低比特部署工具链有直接帮助。

item.title: A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based

Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family. The core challenge is structural heterogene- ity: dynamical systems differ in their governing dynamics, physical scales, and noise levels, precluding a shared representation space for a reusable filter. To bridge this gap, we introduce FilterFM, the first pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems with a single checkpoint. FilterFM employs a hierarchical two-level observation se- quence encoder and a prior-to-posterior state-reconstruction module that together handle varying observation and state dimensions across heterogeneous systems, while modeling state uncertainty via quantile prediction. Trained on a mixture of heterogeneous filtering tasks, FilterFM exhibits superior in-domain performance, delivering significant gains in estimation accuracy, runtime efficiency, and noise robustness compared to existing baselines. item.title: A Novel Approach to Evaluating Evaluation Metrics for Multi-Output Structured Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-29　分类：论文PDF

In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge.

In multi-output structured prediction tasks, while only one ground truth label may be provided in the training data, multiple equally valid outputs may be possible, making reliable evaluation a persistent challenge. We postulate that human evaluators implicitly use task-specific invariants, e.g., object boundaries in colorized images or named entities in translations, to judge if an output is acceptable. Under this assumption, we introduce a notion of approximate task-specific invariants and use them as diagnostic tools to evaluate a variety of existing metrics for vision and language tasks. We use these task invariants as part of a framework to systematically test metric reliability by encouraging domain-relevant invariants in model outputs via an augmented loss function. In our experiments, we observe that enforcing invariants with an augmented loss yields substantial improvements in popular distributional metrics while more traditional metrics change only marginally. Through this invariants-driven evaluation, we expose where standard metrics fail to detect meaningful differences, and we highlight the conditions under which distributional metrics succeed or still fall short.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 投机解码（SD）在 MoE 模型上被预测为批大小与加速呈凹关系、增益峰值在中批；细粒度 MoE 是否打破这一趋势？

方法 在 10 个稀疏 MoE 模型（30B–1T 参数、8–512 专家）上评估，发现细粒度模型低批下提速更高；用最大熵迭代比例拟合（IPF）框架从路由重叠统计预测验证期唯一专家数。

关键数字 IPF 预测唯一专家数误差小于 4%，显著拉近与真实模型曲线的差距并捕捉低批趋势；H100 上 profiling 显示 MoE kernel 带宽利用率高于 attention、L2 吸收共路由专家的重复读取。

为什么值得看 修正了 MoE 投机解码的既有认知，路由重叠建模思路对推理加速器设计有参考价值。

item.title: Two-Stage Clipping: Linear-Time Approximate and Exact Mixed-Norm Projections for Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Transformer 结构化稀疏化中 ℓ1,∞ 投影能诱导列稀疏，但现有近端方法对 n×m 矩阵需 O(nm log(nm))，算力能效受限。

方法 Two-Stage Clipping（TSC）：受双层优化启发但不严格求解，分解为两阶段——先投影组级量分配全局稀疏预算并识别活跃组，再以结果为矩阵系数的组级裁剪阈值；对 n×n 方阵注意力矩阵复杂度降至 O(n²)（对系数个数线性）。

关键数字 摘要未给出统一基准的具体数值；理论上界表明 TSC 与精确近端投影的偏差很小，合成数据上额外欧氏近似代价可忽略，基准测试显示显著优于近端基线。

为什么值得看 把稀疏投影做到线性时间，理论保证+实验验证兼备，对结构化稀疏化落地方向实用。

发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Transformer 结构化稀疏化中 ℓ1,∞ 投影能诱导列稀疏，但现有近端方法对 n×m 矩阵需 O(nm log(nm))，算力能效受限。

方法 Two-Stage Clipping（TSC）：受双层优化启发但不严格求解，分解为两阶段——先投影组级量分配全局稀疏预算并识别活跃组，再以结果为矩阵系数的组级裁剪阈值；对 n×n 方阵注意力矩阵复杂度降至 O(n²)（对系数个数线性）。

关键数字 摘要未给出统一基准的具体数值；理论上界表明 TSC 与精确近端投影的偏差很小，合成数据上额外欧氏近似代价可忽略，基准测试显示显著优于近端基线。

为什么值得看 把稀疏投影做到线性时间，理论保证+实验验证兼备，对结构化稀疏化落地方向实用。

item.title: Tight Bounds for Anonymous Parity Certification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Local certification is the task of verifying graph properties using certificates assigned to vertices and checked using only local information.

Local certification is the task of verifying graph properties using certificates assigned to vertices and checked using only local information. A central question is which properties admit constant-size certificates, independently of network size. A fundamental test case is the parity of the network order. Bousquet, Feuilloley, Valenzuela, and Zeitoun (DISC 2026) showed that the complexity of certifying even order depends dramatically on the verification model. On arbitrary graphs, three bits per vertex suffice with unique identifiers and verification radius two. In the anonymous radius-one model, they established an $Ω(\log\log^* n)$ lower bound and an $O(\log n)$ upper bound. They also showed that constant-size certificates suffice in this model on bounded-expansion classes. In this paper, we settle the complexity of anonymous parity certification on general graphs and further investigate the role of graph sparsity. Our main contributions are: * We close the gap left by Bousquet et al., proving that the local complexity of certifying even order in the anonymous radius-one model is $Θ(\log\log n)$ bits. * We show that on graphs of degeneracy at most $d$, parity can be certified wi…

item.title: The Utility of Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Solar Power Production Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and hybrid modeling have attracted significant attention as approaches for combining physical knowledge with the flexibility of deep learning.

Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and hybrid modeling have attracted significant attention as approaches for combining physical knowledge with the flexibility of deep learning. In this work, we investigate whether these approaches deliver their commonly claimed benefits for large-scale photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting. We develop two hybrid forecasting architectures that integrate the ADR physical PV efficiency model with the TSMixer neural forecasting architecture through feature augmentation and residual learning. The proposed models are evaluated on a dataset comprising over 3 million samples from 3,713 PV installations across 33 European countries. We assess convergence speed, forecasting accuracy, transferability across geographical regions, and data efficiency. Although the physics-informed models seem to exhibit slightly faster convergence during training, they do not achieve consistent improvements in test-set accuracy, generalization, or performance under limited training data compared to the purely data-driven baseline. These findings suggest that, for modern deep forecasting architectures trained on large datasets, explicitly incorporating the ADR physical mode…

item.title: The Role of Quantization in Loss Spikes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 预训练 loss spike 浪费算力，其中一类"定时炸弹"式发散只在长时间训练后出现——其隐藏驱动是什么？

方法 聚焦 LM head 输出 logit 增长：识别出 spike 前伴随 LM head 量化误差快速放大；发现降低数值精度会加速 time-bomb spike、提高精度则增强稳定性；提出用 SGD+momentum 替换 LM head 上的 AdamW 抑制 logit 增长。

关键数字 摘要未给出具体数值；结论是文献中既有缓解手段与本文方法都降低量化误差，指向共同的数值机制。

为什么值得看 把有限精度误差定位为长程预训练不稳定性的隐藏驱动，一个简单的优化器替换就能缓解，训练稳定性方向值得一读。

item.title: The Endgame of FSDP Communication: Layout-Aware Collectives on Copy Engines, RDMA, and NVSwitch
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FSDP2 按参数张量维护参数/梯度，但集合通信在扁平 rank-major 缓冲上进行，布局转换与通信 kernel 双重拖慢 step。

方法 TIDE：基于公开 NCCL 2.31+ API 的零拷贝集合通信，把布局放置折叠进集合寻址；TIDE-AG 用 NVSwitch 组播+节拍式递归倍增 RDMA 直送参数存储；TIDE-RS 直接消费每参数 bf16 梯度、用 copy engine 与短生命周期 CTA 归约为 fp32 分片，两阶段流水分离梯度读取与网络推进。

关键数字 Llama-3.1-70B 8K tokens/GPU 训练中布局转换占 step 时间 6.4%，默认 reduce-scatter 可使本应单波完成的并发 GEMM 慢 69%；64 GPU 上较 Stock FSDP2 step 时间降最多 27.1%，reduce-scatter SM 时间降 12.5–14.5×。

为什么值得看 通信与计算重叠的底层优化，零拷贝+混合精度归约设计对大模型训练栈很有价值。

item.title: The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate.

Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to…

item.title: TGTV: An Interpretable Framework for UAV Fault Detection and Traceability via Spatiotemporal Graph Learning and Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles experience operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures.

Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles experience operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable fault detection and traceability framework that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol…

item.title: Slant: Shaping Traffic for Resource-Efficient Microservices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Microservice architectures rely on load balancers to distribute requests across service replicas, yet existing designs largely optimize for balanced routing without considering how routing shapes autoscaling signals and resource efficiency.

Microservice architectures rely on load balancers to distribute requests across service replicas, yet existing designs largely optimize for balanced routing without considering how routing shapes autoscaling signals and resource efficiency. We present Slant, a resource-aware load balancing framework that intentionally creates safe traffic imbalance to improve resource utilization. Slant profiles service-specific critical points, computes conservative multi-dimensional capacity, derives imbalance-aware routing weights that maintain hot and cold pods, and falls back to safer behavior under anomalies. By exposing clearer utilization signals, Slant works with existing vertical pod autoscalers (VPAs) without modification. Experiments on three microservice benchmarks show that Slant reduces allocated CPU cores by up to 26\% while lowering P99 latency by up to 18\% compared to Round-Robin. Under dynamic workloads, Slant triggers VPA scale-up 45\% faster and completes scale-in 40\% faster. Under anomalies, it recovers 40\% faster from pod failures and limits latency amplification to 1.8$\times$ versus 2.6$\times$ during downstream slowdowns.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Skillful and realistic precipitation forecasting with reinforced diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Accurate precipitation forecasting remains elusive as physics-based models struggle to resolve mesoscale convection and machine learning often yields physically inconsistent, blurred results that consistently underestimate extreme events.

Accurate precipitation forecasting remains elusive as physics-based models struggle to resolve mesoscale convection and machine learning often yields physically inconsistent, blurred results that consistently underestimate extreme events. We present FitzRoy, the first system that simultaneously achieves state-of-the-art predictive skill and physical realism over the continental United States. Through a reinforced diffusion framework, where a conditional discrete diffusion model is refined via reinforcement learning, FitzRoy effectively resolves the long-standing trade-off between pointwise accuracy and structural fidelity. Across lead times up to 24 hours, FitzRoy consistently matches or exceeds state-of-the-art models while preserving structural realism and capturing extreme events. Its low-latency inference further enables deployment in real-time operational settings. In case studies such as the 2025 Texas Hill Country floods and the 2026 Missouri floods, FitzRoy signals record-breaking accumulations that existing models largely missed. By bridging the gap between realism and skill, FitzRoy establishes a new frontier for high-fidelity precipitation forecasting.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SatOps-Decision: Low-Latency Discriminative Decisions for Onboard Satellite Communication Operations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

We propose SatOps-Decision, a method for low-latency decisions in satellite communication operations.

We propose SatOps-Decision, a method for low-latency decisions in satellite communication operations. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first application of Jev-style general-purpose discriminative decision models to satellite operations, and the accompanying benchmark is the first dedicated to this approach. The learned scorer, a locally adapted Laya encoder with its native decision head, selects among supplied operational answers in a single forward pass. The benchmark combines authored operational contracts, controlled state changes and independently checked labels in an auditable construction. Evaluation prioritizes complete-request latency and raw decision accuracy; all main accuracy comparisons use the same 1,024 held-out questions, separate from training and development. SatOps-Decision's local scorer has a median latency of 90.3 ms per decision, versus 493.9 ms for Qwen3.5-0.8B generation and 388.4 ms for OneJev1.6-0.8B: $5.47\times$ and $4.30\times$ speedups based on median request times in the measured FP32/MPS implementations. Its mean raw accuracy is 85.3%, versus 42.5% for frozen Laya, 40.7% for Qwen generation and 58.6% for OneJev. As cloud accuracy references, …

item.title: Rethinking LLM Jailbreak Evaluation: Continuous Risk Landscapes Beyond Binary Outcomes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

A binary success indicator is a natural representation for discriminative tasks such as image classification under adversarial perturbations, where each input is mapped to a single prediction.

A binary success indicator is a natural representation for discriminative tasks such as image classification under adversarial perturbations, where each input is mapped to a single prediction. However, generative tasks are fundamentally different: an LLM jailbreak prompt induces a distribution over open-ended trajectories, while a sampled response reveals only one path. Yet LLM jailbreak evaluation typically retains the binary response indicator underlying attack success rate, obscuring the surrounding structure of possible generations. We introduce a continuous, context-conditioned risk landscape over first-token branches, estimated by fixing candidate openings and repeatedly sampling their continuations. This continuous risk-landscape perspective reveals two complementary properties: current decoder exposure and safe rerouting capacity, which have been obscured by binary-indicator-based ASR. The resulting representation also provides a common basis for comparing clean prompts, attacked variants, and attack strength against a known adaptive defense. Across multiple target models and jailbreak attacks, we uncover risky branches beneath apparently safe outputs, identify qualitativel…

item.title: REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations.

Real-time forecasting of resting-state EEG signals is required by applications like brain-state-dependent stimulation, where computer generated actions are coupled with ongoing neural oscillations. Recently, the deep learning model WaveNet was proposed for the forecasting task. It shows superior accuracy compared to the prevailing method, the linear autoregressive (AR) model, and provides a built-in uncertainty measure due to its probabilistic modeling framework. However, inference using WaveNet is too slow for real-time use due to its sample-by-sample autoregressive operation: a single forecast requires evaluating the model tens or hundreds of times depending on the length of the prediction window. In this paper, we present REVBRAIN, a probabilistic deep learning method that produces forecasts in real time by generating the forecast over the whole prediction horizon at once. item.title: Progressive Coupling Method for Diffusion Posterior Sampling in Ptychography
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Ptychography is a computational imaging method that reconstructs a sample from overlapping diffraction measurements.

Ptychography is a computational imaging method that reconstructs a sample from overlapping diffraction measurements. This technique relies on these overlapping measurements to provide the redundancy information needed for robust reconstruction, but dense scanning increases acquisition time and data volume. Reducing scan overlaps can improve measurement efficiency but weakens the physical constraints available for reconstruction. Diffusion models provide strong learned prior information, offering a promising approach to compensate for the loss of measurement redundancy. However, effectively utilizing this prior information under weak measurement constraints remains a challenge. We propose a progressive coupling posterior sampling (PCPS) method, which allows for a broader exploration of the solution space under high uncertainty while maintaining stronger diffusion-guided consistency as the reconstruction becomes more refined. Experiments on real X-ray ptychographic data at various scan overlaps demonstrate that PCPS consistently improves reconstruction accuracy compared to traditional iterative methods and existing diffusion posterior samplers, especially at low overlaps. Test-time training (TTT) layers replace the linear fast-weight memory of modern recurrent architectures with a small neural network trained online by gradient descent.

Test-time training (TTT) layers replace the linear fast-weight memory of modern recurrent architectures with a small neural network trained online by gradient descent. This nonlinear memory is more expressive than the linear memories of Gated DeltaNet and Mamba-2, but is difficult to parallelize: existing implementations such as TTT-MLP rely on sequential, block-wise weight updates that run several times slower than chunkwise-parallel linear recurrences. Moreover, their block-wise execution only approximates the token-by-token online recurrence, whereas linear recurrences admit an exact chunkwise-parallel evaluation. We introduce ParaTTT (PTTT), an algorithm for parallelizing arbitrarily deep nonlinear memories by iteratively refining estimates of the inner-loop gradient trajectory. Starting from a guess of the hidden-layer gradients, each refinement consists of three chunkwise-parallel passes: a forward pass that evaluates the resulting feature trajectory, an exact gated-delta-rule pass that computes the readout trajectory and its feature gradients, and a backward pass that propagates these gradients into a new estimate. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

In this paper, we investigate decentralized online convex optimization with compressed communication, where $n$ learners over a network jointly minimize a sequence of global loss functions based only

In this paper, we investigate decentralized online convex optimization with compressed communication, where $n$ learners over a network jointly minimize a sequence of global loss functions based only on their local losses and compressed messages from their neighbors. The best known regret bounds for this problem are $O(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1}\sqrt{T\ln n})$ and $O(ω^{-1}nρ^{-2}\ln n\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respectively, where $ρ\in(0,1)$ is the spectral gap of the communication matrix and $ω\in(0,1]$ is the compression quality factor. Compared with the corresponding lower bounds of $Ω(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $Ω(ω^{-1}nρ^{-1/2}\ln T)$, these upper bounds exhibit polynomial gaps in their dependence on $ρ^{-1}$. To close these gaps, we first develop Ascent-gossip, which combines an online compression strategy with a Chebyshev recursion and attains a faster consensus rate than existing compressed gossip methods. Furthermore, by adopting Ascent-gossip, we propose an online algorithm that achieves optimal regret bounds of $\widetilde O(ω^{-1/2}nρ^{-1/4}\sqrt{T})$ and $\widetilde O(ω^{-1}nρ^{-1/2}\ln T)$ for convex and strongly convex loss functions, respecti…

On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms.

On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. item.title: On the Generalization Gap of Streaming Federated Learning with Markovian Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Streaming federated learning (SFL) allows clients to train a shared model from continuously arriving data without retaining large local datasets.

Streaming federated learning (SFL) allows clients to train a shared model from continuously arriving data without retaining large local datasets. Such streams often exhibit temporal dependence, yet its effect on generalization remains poorly understood. In this paper we study the expected generalization gap of the aggregated model when client data follow Markov processes, using information-theoretic and rate-distortion techniques. Our framework accommodates heterogeneous Markovian dynamics across clients and distinguishes temporal dependence from information acquired during local learning. We establish bounds under cross-entropy loss, specializing them to Linear Next-Token Prediction (LNTP) and Self-Attention Next-Token Prediction (SANTP). These results quantify the effects of client count, communication rounds, sample size, data dimension, mixing time, and context length. In particular, they reveal a communication--generalization tradeoff: although frequent aggregation may help optimization, it can weaken generalization guarantees. They also suggest a potential advantage of distributed over centralized streaming learning under a fixed total data budget. Temporal dependence enters …

item.title: MCCL: Training Pytorch models across a fleet of Macs at Skywalker Sound
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Skywalker Sound 有 200+ 台 M4 Max Mac Studio（10GbE），艺术家不用时闲置大量统一内存与算力，但 PyTorch 缺少 Apple MPS 的加速分布式后端。

方法 MCCL：首个开源多节点 PyTorch 训练 MPS 后端（Metal Communication Collective Library），在交换以太网上实现 all-reduce 等集合通信。

关键数字 24 节点上大 all-reduce 达 TCP goodput 的 98–99.7%；113.5M 参数 ViT 训练从 198 提到 4568 samples/s，并行效率 95.9%；单台 M4 Max 约为 A100 FP32 矩阵乘吞吐的 1.7×，5.5 台匹敌 A100 TF32；夜间 100 台闲置 Mac 跑 12 小时约抵每年 20 万美元云算力。

为什么值得看 把闲置 Mac 集群变成训练资源的完整工程方案，成本账清晰，对算力紧张团队有吸引力。

item.title: MASS: Multi-mask Selective Self-Distillation for Leakage-Resilient Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

On-policy self-distillation enables the same model to act as student and teacher, with dense token-level supervision obtained by the teacher being given access to privileged information.

On-policy self-distillation enables the same model to act as student and teacher, with dense token-level supervision obtained by the teacher being given access to privileged information. However, conditioning the teacher on a single reference can concentrate its predictions on one reasoning trajectory and limit transfer to the student. We propose Multi-Mask Selective Self-Distillation (MASS), which approximates the unavailable marginal over diverse reference realizations using multiple independently masked views of one verified solution. MASS aggregates these complementary teacher predictions, selectively transfers reliable token-level corrections, and adaptively focuses masking on influential reference spans. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model families, MASS consistently outperforms strong self-distillation baselines.

item.title: Loss is Not Behavior: A Unified Output-Space Analysis of Gradient-Based Machine Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Gradient-based machine unlearning methods typically ``unlearn'' by optimizing forget and retain losses, but similar losses do not necessarily imply similar output-space behavior.

Gradient-based machine unlearning methods typically ``unlearn'' by optimizing forget and retain losses, but similar losses do not necessarily imply similar output-space behavior. Prior work has shown that high forget loss alone does not certify that unlearning has produced retraining-like output behavior. We therefore ask: when a gradient-based unlearner differs from the model that would have been learned on only the retain data, what structure does the resulting output-space gap have? We derive closed-form expressions for this gap in linear regression, with an extension to nonlinear models via a generalized Gauss-Newton and local linearity approximations. Our analysis puts various gradient-based methods under a unified framework parametrized by geometry, reweighting, and projection. Two leverage matrices emerge that capture the forget-retain entanglement under the retrained model geometry: forget self-leverage and retain cross-leverage. We show both theoretically and empirically that these two leverage matrices drive the impact of the forget residual on the forget and retain outputs, and existing methods account for this geometry only partially. item.title: Jailbreak Connectivity: Towards Diverse, Transferable, and Universal Multimodal Large Language Model Jailbreak
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to visual jailbreak attacks that bypass safety safeguards.

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are vulnerable to visual jailbreak attacks that bypass safety safeguards. Existing methods typically optimize isolated adversarial examples, limiting attack diversity, transferability, and generalization. We propose Jailbreak Connectivity (JC), a framework based on the observation that effective adversarial inputs can be connected through low-loss regions in image space. JC optimizes continuous adversarial paths: path sampling yields diverse jailbreak images, lightweight surrogate classifiers guide cross-model transfer, and a distribution-level objective enables universal attacks across harmful queries. On MM-SafetyBench, JC achieves average attack success rates of 84.01%, 85.77%, and 97.95% on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B-IT, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by up to 68.36 percentage points. In black-box evaluations, JC improves attack success rates over FigStep by 24.69 and 27.34 percentage points on GPT-5.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, respectively. These findings reveal structured vulnerabilities in MLLM safety alignment and inform more comprehensive security evaluation.

item.title: IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware.

The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, an…

item.title: How Much Do Teacher Bridges Matter in Interleaved On-Policy Distillation?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher predictions on student-generated responses.

On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student using teacher predictions on student-generated responses. Some methods insert teacher-written segments, or bridges, but disagree on how to train on those tokens. We compare no loss, forward KL and reverse KL on identical trajectories using Qwen3-1.7B as student and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as teacher. We separate gradients by which model wrote each token. Under our short training runs and BF16 inference, pre-specified tests detected no added accuracy benefit from teacher text as context or as a training target. A one-paragraph bridge after the student's first paragraph is only 2.7% of the tokens and contributes a small gradient nearly orthogonal to the student-token gradient. In this main comparison, the three loss treatments gave similar gradient directions and were statistically equivalent in accuracy within a +/-5 percentage-point margin. An exploratory pilot placing the bridge where failed responses disagreed most with the teacher suggested a benefit from teacher-token loss. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Large-scale PDE pre-training trains a single model on the data from multiple partial differential equations (PDEs).

Large-scale PDE pre-training trains a single model on the data from multiple partial differential equations (PDEs). However, adding heterogeneous PDEs with different governing equations, physical variables, and variable interactions does not always improve predictive performance across tasks. Existing PDE mixture-of-experts models mitigate cross-task interference through learned routing, but typically use homogeneous expert architectures, making it difficult to directly reflect differences in state evolution across equations. We introduce HotPOT, an operator transformer with heterogeneous physics experts for large-scale PDE pre-training. HotPOT uses a shared encoder to capture information common across PDEs, while each PDE family uses a neural-numerical expert that pairs a learnable predictor with a fixed numerical update containing no trainable parameters. Each predictor outputs the quantities required by its paired numerical update, which then computes the next state. This design allows different PDEs to share a common encoder while retaining their own learnable predictors and numerical updates. Experiments across five PDE families and six settings show that HotPOT outperforms Mo…

item.title: Hardwired Distributed Processing Units at the Sensor: Truly Parallel Vision Pre-Processing that Frees the Host CPU
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Conventional vision pipelines route every pixel to a host processor, which must then wait for a complete frame before it can act and devote part of each frame period to routine pre-processing.

Conventional vision pipelines route every pixel to a host processor, which must then wait for a complete frame before it can act and devote part of each frame period to routine pre-processing. We examine an alternative organisation in which this work is distributed across hardwired distributed processing units (HDPUs): small, fixed datapaths attached directly to the sensor, each committed to a single always-on task, operating truly in parallel on the same pixel stream and delivering compact results to the host. From one library of 3x3 operators sharing a common two-clock latency, we construct three HDPUs (Canny edges, Harris corners, and a line tracker that issues a steering decision) and run them side by side on a single camera stream in a low-cost Artix-7 FPGA, at a cost of 2,568 LUTs and an estimated 0.318 W. Every stage of every unit is bit-exact with its software model. In a full-system simulation with a datasheet camera model, each decision leaves its HDPU within 11.03 camera lines of the pixel that produced it, 22-67x sooner than the earliest moment at which a frame-based program on the host could respond; the HDPU latency varies by no more than 17 ns, whereas the host's own…

item.title: GearUp: DAG-aware Acceleration for Serverless Inference Serving via Slack-guided Pre-loading
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Serverless platforms increasingly host machine learning (ML) inference workflows, modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of interdependent functions.

Serverless platforms increasingly host machine learning (ML) inference workflows, modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of interdependent functions. Beyond container startup, each ML node must load libraries, model weights, and CUDA kernels before it can run. These costs accumulate along dependent DAG paths and place initialization on the end-to-end critical path. Existing systems optimize one half of this problem. DAG-agnostic pre-loading prepares nodes the request may never reach, wasting host and GPU memory. DAG-aware serving routes and scales whole functions, leaving the loading stages inside a node untouched. This paper presents GearUp, a serverless DAG inference serving system that removes ML-node loading from the end-to-end critical path at low resource cost. GearUp profiles the loading stages of each node and schedules them inside the slack time the DAG exposes, hiding initialization behind upstream execution. It reuses initialized instances within and across requests to avoid redundant cold starts. A probabilistic, traffic-adaptive keep-alive policy sets how long idle instances are retained, balancing memory cost against cold-start risk under bursty load. On the AMBER …

item.title: GI-RTL-Fuzz: Grammar-Informed RTL Generation with LLMs for End-to-End Differential Simulator Fuzzing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy.

Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy. To systematically stress-test these tools, we introduce GI-RTL-Fuzz, a grammar-informed fuzzing framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate high-quality RTL test cases. Our key innovation is guiding the LLM's generation process using Backus-Naur Form (BNF) grammar coverage information, enabling the exploration of complex and rarely-tested language features. By performing differential testing against different RTL simulators, our framework uncovered a significant number of previously unknown inconsistencies in both the linting process and simulation results of major Verilog simulators.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FlatCake: A Flat KVCache Storage Architecture for LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 KV cache 复用加速 LLM serving，但现有 DRAM/SSD 分层层级假设被生产负载打破：双峰复用让 SSD 进入关键读路径，DRAM 暂存与驱逐排序又阻塞 SSD 恢复。

方法 FlatCake 把 DRAM 与 NVMe SSD 视为统一 64 位地址空间中的对等介质；利用 KV 块一次性写入、不可变、会话级复用的特性，创建时按会话连续、层主序直接放置目标介质且永不迁移；经 GPUDirect Storage 合并流式读入 GPU 窗口，DRAM/SSD 请求队列解耦防队头阻塞。

关键数字 Claude Code 生产 trace + DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上，负载升高时维持 94% cache 命中（Mooncake 为 64%），消除 Mooncake 6.5–6.7× SSD 读放大，峰值平均 TTFT 降 1.6×，总 token 吞吐提升 1.6×；Llama-3.1-70B 8K–128K 上下文平均 TTFT 较 Mooncake 最多降 2.4×。

为什么值得看 颠覆分层存储假设的扁平 KV 存储设计，实测数据扎实，对长会话 agent 场景价值大。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Tabular-to-image encoding methods, which transform tabular data into image-like representations, have shown promising results in predictive tasks.

Tabular-to-image encoding methods, which transform tabular data into image-like representations, have shown promising results in predictive tasks. Despite their benefits, these methods follow a centralized paradigm, in which the data are collected and models are trained on a central device. This raises privacy and security concerns, particularly the risk of data leakage, unauthorized data collection and access to users' private information. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized framework in which multiple clients jointly optimize a shared model without directly sharing training data. We introduce Fed-IGTD, a horizontal FL-based approach in which clients share a common feature space and upload only local statistics, from which the server reconstructs the global correlation matrix and obtains a feature-to-pixel mapping to train a convolutional neural network via Federated Averaging (FedAvg). We studied two differential privacy (DP) mechanisms: (i) a one-shot Gaussian mechanism protecting the correlation-aggregation step; and (ii) a client-level DP-FedAvg variant protecting the training with privacy loss composed via a Renyi-DP accountant. item.title: Exploring and optimizing the Vivado Flow on large FPGA designs: A Practical Analysis of Strategies and Their Impact on Timing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications.

Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

item.title: ExplainCC: Explaining Correlated Clusters by Node Labels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

An increasingly important requirement for clustering algorithms is that decisions and outcomes need to be clearly understandable for human users.

An increasingly important requirement for clustering algorithms is that decisions and outcomes need to be clearly understandable for human users. We address this requirement for the Correlation Clustering (CC) problem, in case the objects to be clustered are accompanied by labels. In CC one seeks to partition a set of objects into clusters based on pairwise similarity and dissimilarity information. Our proposed model only considers clusters that can be explained by a label tree, which is essentially a decision tree that partitions the objects according to labels. The goal is to find an explainable partition of the data that minimizes the CC objective function. We formalize this problem from a theoretical viewpoint, and prove several hardness of approximation results, also when constraining the size of the tree. Our proposed greedy method finds locally optimal splits, and works recursively in a top-down approach. To efficiently compute the best split, we carefully maintain certain counters. An experimental evaluation demonstrates its effectiveness. The proposed algorithm processes graphs with over million edges in a few minutes, can find the ground truth in synthetic data, and is ab…

item.title: Dual DeltaNet: Value-Side Memory Reorganization for Linear Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 线性注意力/SSM 靠固定大小循环状态保持历史关联，delta 规则能减少干扰，但不考虑相关 value 特征在状态中的分布——能否从值侧重组内存？

方法 把状态视为 d_k 个地址存储 d_v 维值的库；在 Kimi Delta Attention 基础上加"值侧 delta 规则"（用当前值特征重排其占据的地址），形成双面 delta 规则；推导 chunkwise 并行训练算法与 rank-2 递推提升推理算术强度。

关键数字 与 KDA、GDN-2、Mamba-3 相比，DDN 在语言建模、零样本下游任务与检索上整体最强，训练/推理开销相对 KDA 仅小幅增加。

为什么值得看 线性注意力内存管理的机理级改进，代码开源，对高效序列模型有直接价值。

item.title: DistOptimize: Automatic Optimization of Distributed Protocols
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Distributed consensus and consistency protocols are difficult to reason about yet foundational to the cloud; as such, they often undergo a rigorous proof and formal verification process before deployment.

Distributed consensus and consistency protocols are difficult to reason about yet foundational to the cloud; as such, they often undergo a rigorous proof and formal verification process before deployment. The same level of rigor is rarely applied to protocol modifications, which occur frequently in production and threaten to compromise safety. In this paper, we eliminate the risk of safety violations from manual modifications by presenting an automatic optimizer for distributed protocols: DistOptimize. DistOptimize adapts throughput optimizations from academic languages to frameworks used in production, verifying the correctness of the rewrites in Rocq and automating their application through a combination of calibration and ILP-based search space navigation. Applied to both fundamental distributed protocols and protocols used at AWS, DistOptimize improves throughput by up to 4x and increases latency by at most 0.3ms.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Data Amount Heterogeneity Improves Performance in Federated Learning for Neuroimaging
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Federated Learning (FL) allows for secure analysis of distributed data without data sharing.

Federated Learning (FL) allows for secure analysis of distributed data without data sharing. We and others have successfully applied FL to neuroimaging tasks, such as Alzheimer's disease classification from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). FL trains a deep learning model locally at each site, encrypts the local model parameters and sends them to a federation controller that aggregates the local models under homomorphic encryption, the resulting community model is sent back to the sites for further training, and the process repeats for a number of rounds. FL often achieves learning performance (e.g., accuracy) close to centralized training, but no data leaves the sites and model parameters are protected through encryption and other measures. In this paper, we show that federations composed of sites with heterogeneous amounts of data (1 large site plus small sites) perform better than homogeneous (same data per site) federations, particularly in low data regimes, while reaching performance close to centralized training. Having a big site often results in faster convergence and higher final accuracy. Heterogeneous federations better exploit sites with small amounts of data…

FL trains a deep learning model locally at each site, encrypts the local model parameters and sends them to a federation controller that aggregates the local models under homomorphic encryption, the resulting community model is sent back to the sites for further training, and the process repeats for a number of rounds. FL often achieves learning performance (e.g., accuracy) close to centralized training, but no data leaves the sites and model parameters are protected through encryption and other measures. In this paper, we show that federations composed of sites with heterogeneous amounts of data (1 large site plus small sites) perform better than homogeneous (same data per site) federations, particularly in low data regimes, while reaching performance close to centralized training. Having a big site often results in faster convergence and higher final accuracy. Heterogeneous federations better exploit sites with small amounts of data…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Fast inference and strict constraint satisfaction are essential for learning-based decision-making.

Fast inference and strict constraint satisfaction are essential for learning-based decision-making. Existing methods often rely on constraint-specific projections or feasible-set parameterizations, while iterative repair can be costly. We introduce Convex-SKM-Net, a convex constraint-satisfaction layer that forms linearization halfspaces from residual and (sub)gradient oracles without constraint-specific inequality projectors. It applies fixed-depth dual projected-gradient descent (dual PGD) to minimum-displacement block problems using GPU-friendly matrix operations. We jointly learn the predictor and a positive-definite mobility, adapting the correction geometry to improve objective quality. We prove convergence of the outer iterates at fixed dual depth and linear convergence in distance under Slater's condition and bounded subgradients. All our test outputs on three second-order-cone model-predictive control (SOC-MPC) horizons and six power-system convex relaxations satisfy a $10^{-3}$ feasibility tolerance. item.title: Continual Adaptation Across Modalities: Learning and Forgetting in Unified Multimodal Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Unified multimodal models (UMMs), which can process and generate diverse modalities within a single framework, have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm.

Unified multimodal models (UMMs), which can process and generate diverse modalities within a single framework, have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm. However, when these models undergo continual learning on multiple tasks across different modalities, their learning and forgetting dynamics remain poorly understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate how architectural design and adaptation method shape intra-modal learning and cross-modal interference between the generation and understanding sides. Specifically, we report three findings. First, the severity of cross-modal interference decreases with the degree of modality-specific parameter isolation. Second, a within-model asymmetry: the generation side of a UMM is markedly more fragile than its understanding side. Third, what post-training adds is the first to be forgotten: purely post-training capabilities such as personalized generation collapse by 84\% to 90\%, while pretraining capabilities remain stable. Together, these results clarify how parameter isolation and post-training fragility shape UMMs' learning and forgetting dynamics, offering a starting point for developing continually evolving UMMs.

item.title: Communication-Efficient Clustered Federated Learning in Non-IID Wireless Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Current and emerging mobile networks face increasing privacy, scalability, and performance challenges as distributed learning becomes essential for advanced 6G services.

Current and emerging mobile networks face increasing privacy, scalability, and performance challenges as distributed learning becomes essential for advanced 6G services. These challenges are amplified by the presence of non-IID data, naturally arising in heterogeneous wireless environments, that degrade the performance of standard Federated Learning (FL) approaches. To address non-IID data across clients, we propose a Clustered Federated Learning (CFL) framework that assigns clients to specialized models during training. Data-domain clustering initializes model-based clustering, enabling identification and exploitation of client similarities without sharing raw data while reducing communication cost. Motivated by mmWave beam selection, we evaluate our methods on a wireless simulation dataset (DeepMIMO) and complement it with two non-IID benchmarks (FEMNIST, Rotated CIFAR-10) to isolate different non-IID characteristics. Our best configurations improve accuracy over IFCA by 4.8 pp on DeepMIMO and 10.6 pp on FEMNIST while reducing downlink data volume by 83.1 % on FEMNIST compared to IFCA. item.title: Closed Gates Leak: Decomposing Adjacent-Layer Cancellation in Gated Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

In transformer language models with gated multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), adjacent layers write partly against each other into the residual stream.

In transformer language models with gated multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), adjacent layers write partly against each other into the residual stream. Previous work interpreted this cancellation as layers proposing features and the next layer selectively rejecting the inappropriate ones. We decompose the cancellation by removing the previous layer's write from the input of the next MLP: what the next layer writes along that write splits into what it writes anyway and how much less its MLP writes because the write is present, which we call the damping, and we trace the damping to the neurons that carry it. In gated MLPs the damping is carried by neurons whose gates are closed. SiLU and GELU are slightly negative below zero, so a closed gate still passes a small negative multiple of what the neuron reads, and a neuron whose output weight points along its input weight then subtracts a fraction of the direction it read. item.title: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 多 agent 并发长上下文 prefill 会占满 GPU，CPU 是可替代路径，但现有 CPU attention kernel 不适应多级缓存层次、线程调度不佳。

方法 CACPU：分层缓存阻塞（tiered cache blocking）+ 核内任务分发（in-kernel task dispatching）的因果全序列 prefill 注意力 kernel。

关键数字 较 PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention、SGLang 的注意力 kernel 最高提速 2.01×；集成进 SGLang 后 Llama-3.1-8B 的 TTFT 最高降低 1.74×，精度不变。

为什么值得看 CPU 侧 prefill 卸载的实用 kernel 工程，缓存感知与负载均衡设计对异构调度有参考意义。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Neural-network-based PDE solvers require architectural choices, particularly the number of layers and neurons per layer.

Neural-network-based PDE solvers require architectural choices, particularly the number of layers and neurons per layer. Fixing a single Gaussian radial basis function (RBF) feature layer and taking the number of features to the continuum limit removes the need to prescribe a finite feature count or select individual feature centers, thereby reducing representation arbitrariness. Motivated by this principle, we introduce Continuum-Feature Kernel Solver (CFKS), a deterministic framework for PDEs obtained by analytically marginalizing a bounded continuum of Gaussian RBF features. CFKS works directly with the resulting continuum-feature mean kernel and its operator-applied counterparts, parameterized by prescribed Gaussian widths and bounded center distributions. For linear PDEs, CFKS leads to symmetric operator-kernel collocation systems with null-space enforcement of physical constraints. Nonlinear PDEs are addressed through linearized initialization and nonlinear least-squares residual minimization using analytical kernel derivatives and Jacobians. item.description:

Fast and accurate models for AC power flow (ACPF) are increasingly important as modern electrical grids require more frequent system analyses.

Fast and accurate models for AC power flow (ACPF) are increasingly important as modern electrical grids require more frequent system analyses. Graph neural networks (GNNs) naturally exploit electrical grid topology, yet the effects of architectural design choices on predictive performance remain poorly understood given differences in graph representations and evaluation settings across studies. We present a unified benchmark of representative GNN architectures for ACPF prediction under a common experimental framework. All models use identical preprocessing and training procedures and comparable parameter budgets, isolating the impact of message-passing mechanisms and inductive biases. We also analyze errors by distance from the slack bus and systematically ablate key design components. We evaluate predictive accuracy and physical consistency on the IEEE 14-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems. Results indicate that anisotropic message-passing architectures offer the most favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and physical consistency under the studied parameter and topology constraints. Most multimodal classifiers assume that all useful evidence is available upfront, whereas clinical inquiry is sequential. We present a synthetic evaluation framework separating objective multimodal inference from active inquiry. An objective model maps synthetic tongue, bilateral multipressure pulse, and acoustic observations to eight syndrome families. A provenance-bearing Knowledge Core and training-only answer model support Bayesian narrowing over 33 fine terms using 25 typed questions, while seven safety questions remain outside the diagnostic posterior. item.title: Adversarial Self-Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Even though current safety-aligned language models are able to refuse harmful requests, their guard can still be bypassed by adversarial perturbations.

Even though current safety-aligned language models are able to refuse harmful requests, their guard can still be bypassed by adversarial perturbations. As in other domains, adversarial training is considered a standard defense. However, due to the autoregressive nature of language generation, supervised finetuning on template refusals does not necessarily teach the model to refuse. Evidence of this is that the adversarially trained model still complies when the attacker injects a compliant prefill. We propose Adversarial Self-Distillation (ASD), which extends a model's own safe behavior to the space of adversarial perturbations. The teacher (the model itself given the clean prompt) can refuse the harmful request by default, or with the help of an additional instruction in its context. ASD distills this knowledge to the student (which is the same model under attack) at the prefixes that the student visits (due to on-policy sampling). These potentially include compliant openings. ASD achieves lower attack success than state-of-the-art defenses with little loss in multiple-choice accuracy, and it becomes able to recover a refusal even after a compliant opening.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: A Separation Principle for Adversarial Attacks and Defense of Graph Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-28　分类：论文PDF

Adversarial attacks on graph neural networks (GNNs) have been studied as a model-centric optimization problem driven by gradients, learned policies, or meta-learning, with the graph treated as a passive substrate.

Adversarial attacks on graph neural networks (GNNs) have been studied as a model-centric optimization problem driven by gradients, learned policies, or meta-learning, with the graph treated as a passive substrate. This view overlooks a defining feature of GNNs: their predictions are produced by structured message passing along the graph, so their adversarial vulnerabilities are encoded as much in the geometry of the graph as in the learned weights. We develop a structure-driven framework for feature attacks in which the attack is derived from the spectral properties of the normalized adjacency operator. Its central result is a separation principle: under a natural relaxation of the attack objective, the optimal feature perturbation is rank one and factorizes into a graph-dependent component (degree-proportional spatial allocation, depending only on the graph) and a weight-dependent component (top singular vector of the composed weights, depending only on the weights). Node degree thus emerges as the fundamental graph quantity governing adversarial vulnerability to feature perturbations. 研究问题 前沿 LLM 能写对多数单算子 CUDA kernel，但在罕见架构（新加速器+冷门编程语言）上精度崩塌；稀缺设备时间下如何自动优化 kernel？

方法 面向 FuriosaAI RNGD NPU（Rust DSL）构建 LLM agent 优化循环：自建目标知识（总结 DSL 文档、微基准测芯片、记录编译器合法性规则并在工具链变化时复核）；按 kernel 维护 Design Tree 做角色化搜索；上机前用廉价检查筛选设计，后期仅在与最佳 kernel 反复对比后才采纳改动。

关键数字 12 天优化 Gemma-4-12B 三个 decode kernel，最终较官方基线几何平均提速 9.293×，每个 kernel 距离仅搬权重所需周期 1.25× 以内。

为什么值得看 稀缺设备+嘈杂测量约束下 agent 自动优化硬件的完整案例，代码已开源。

item.title: p-DCIM: A 28nm Probabilistic SRAM DCIM based Ising Machine for Near-Memory Context Selection in LLM-RAG Pipeline
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 RAG 的证据选择阶段越来越多地交给反复的 LLM rerank，给推理管线带来可观能耗。

方法 将证据选择重构为 QUBO 问题，在双模数字存内计算宏上求解：同一 MAC 数据通路既计算嵌入相似度填充 QUBO 系数，又评估驱动退火的逐自旋哈密顿差；数字平面计数控制配合 SRAM 伪读随机位翻转实现片上分级冷却。

关键数字 28nm 流片 [0.16 mm²、0.41 mW]；宏归一化选择能耗估计比 LLM 基线低 6 个数量级以上，单查询总能耗降低 67%，token 级 F1 与基线相当。

为什么值得看 将 Ising 机作为近存求解器替换 LLM rerank 的完整流片验证，是存内计算在 LLM 管线落地的代表性工作。

item.title: Where Should the Evaluation Budget Go in LLM-Driven Agent Scaffold Evolution?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation.

Large language model (LLM)-driven agent scaffold evolution improves agent workflows through iterative candidate generation and evaluation. Evaluation both guides subsequent search and determines the final scaffold, but evaluating every candidate on the full task set incurs substantial execution costs. We investigate how evaluation budgets can be allocated across these two roles. Our experiments show that sparse feedback can sustain productive evolution, while additional targeted evaluation improves final selection. Replay analyses further show that shared informative items and a common scoring reference support comparisons among closely matched candidates. Motivated by these findings, we propose \method, an evaluation allocation framework that combines sparse search-time feedback with targeted final confirmation. A short fully evaluated warm-up establishes a shared informative core and calibrates a response model whose item parameters remain fixed during search. After search, \method refits the model and applies paired successive halving, reusing accumulated observations and executing only missing evaluations. Across four benchmarks and two evolution frameworks, \method achieves hi…

item.title: When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers.

For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers. Yet refusal alone is not necessarily evidence of such recognition: models may refuse because of unrelated safety constraints or without identifying the missing evidence. We study how refusal on visually unanswerable questions is shaped by three sources of control: inference-time instructions, post-training, and internal activation interventions. Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples. We find that refusal is highly sensitive to both the meaning and placement of instructions, with model-specific changes at the sample level that are obscured by aggregate refusal rates. Evidence-aware and general refusal instructions have stronger effects than an intentionally mismatched safety instruction. Post-training produces larger increases in refusal, but can also ind…

item.title: When All Rollouts Fail: Policy-Compatible Joint Decoding for Hard-Problem Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models.

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) derives its learning signal from binary rewards via on-policy exploration and becomes a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning of large language models. Yet it faces a learning cliff on problems beyond model's current ability: when every rollout fails, the samples reveal nothing about a correct solution, and group-relative estimators (e.g., GRPO, RLOO) collapse the update to zero advantage. Expert trajectories offer a remedy, but they are incompatible with the current policy and often lie in the student's low-probability regions, so the surviving updates demand large parameter shifts and decay into surface-level imitation rather than transferable reasoning. We argue that a useful learning signal on hard problems must be both verifiably correct and sufficiently compatible with the current policy. item.title: Variational Optimal Control for Diffusion Guidance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We present a variational control framework that connects sampling-time guidance and reward-based model adaptation through a shared Jacobian pullback.

We present a variational control framework that connects sampling-time guidance and reward-based model adaptation through a shared Jacobian pullback. Starting from terminal reward maximization with a path-space KL penalty, the Gibbs variational principle and Doob transform yield a correction to the generative dynamics. A local denoising approximation exposes the pullback that transports output preferences to the controlled variable. This construction gives Variational Optimal Guidance (VOG) in state space and extends to Distilled Variational Optimal Control (DVOC) by amortizing locally improved endpoints into model parameters. The resulting controls share a local variational rule: VOG acts through the denoising Jacobian, while DVOC realizes the parameter pullback by endpoint distillation. Under a linear MMSE model, VOG's exact correction lies in the data subspace. On ImageNet, VOG reduces DiT-XL/2 FID from 2.27 to 2.04 at 250 sampling steps and from 7.58 to 4.44 at 25 steps. After 20 updates on Z-Image-Turbo, DVOC improves HPSv3++ and four held-out evaluator scores over the untrained model, with the highest corresponding means among the trained methods compared. These results conne…

item.title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation.

Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. item.title: Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design.

PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. Our adapters integrate pretrained all-atom representations through two mechanisms: enriching the diffusion model's molecular block features and incorporating pairwise structural information into the geometric diffusion model's denoiser. Theoretically, we prove that the augmented denoiser preserves geometry and pairwise attention fusion provides additional attention ex…

item.title: Taming Multi-Dimensional Skew in Sparse Matrix Multiplication with Contention-Aware Scheduling [Technical Report]
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 SpGEMM（稀疏通用矩阵乘）在真实负载中普遍存在偏斜模式，性能受两类并存根因制约：多维偏斜（计算代价、输出密度、数据局部性失衡无法由单一平衡指标刻画）与缓存争用（稠密子结构引发片上干扰）。

方法 自适应 morsel 调度（AMS）：以固定结果尺寸的 morsel 解耦偏斜维度，集成争用感知负载均衡与数据感知 SMT 激活器缓解缓存争用，配合按 morsel 自适应选择最优累加器的混合累加机制。

关键数字 在矩阵平方、关系查询、图分析等任务上，偏斜负载显著超越 SOTA 方法，非偏斜负载保持可比性能；带宽利用率同步改善，效果跨负载与硬件系统稳定。

为什么值得看 对稀疏内核负载失衡根因做了清晰归因，调度方案对图计算与数据库内核开发者有直接借鉴价值。

item.title: TRIDENT-Seq: Profile-Matched Prefix-Future Contrast for Label-Efficient Payment Risk Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Ant International accumulates large volumes of transaction history across users and payment businesses.

Ant International accumulates large volumes of transaction history across users and payment businesses. Confirmed fraud and chargeback outcomes, by contrast, are scarce, delayed, and specific to each business. A single encoder pretrained on unlabeled histories could serve all businesses, but only if pretraining captures the behavior that separates risk. Coarse activity differences can make contrastive pretraining on transaction logs too easy: transaction volume, amount, and timing can distinguish a history's continuation from arbitrary candidates without modeling how payment resources are used. We present TRIDENT-Seq, a transaction foundation model trained with Prefix-Future Contrast (PFC). PFC matches each prefix to a summary of its subsequent behavior among candidates with similar activity profiles; activity prediction and dispersion regularization act on the encoder output. Across three production payment businesses, the pretrained encoder improves average precision (AP) and recall at a 0.5% intervention budget over architecture-matched scratch training in all six business-budget settings. With a fixed validation set, it exceeds full-label scratch training in mean AP and recall …

item.title: TERRA: Task-Oriented Edge AI for Regional Fire Detection with Identity-Free Reporting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 分布式火灾监测中大量传感设备共享上行链路，目标只是定位有火情证据的区域而非恢复单设备读数，如何高效上报？

方法 TERRA 框架=任务导向本地推理+身份无关区域标记上报+置换不变区域证据聚合；两种上报模式：TERRA-Score（量化本地火灾概率）与 TERRA-Feature（紧凑学习表示，接收端用 DeepSets 聚合）。

关键数字 EN54 数据集 15 种传感模态上，9 份报告且消息完全恢复时 TERRA-Feature 以 24-bit 载荷达 AUPRC 0.990，TERRA-Score 仅 6-bit 达 0.987；FAR≤1% 时 MDR 均为 1.81%。

为什么值得看 任务导向边缘 AI 的典型案例，身份无关+置换不变聚合对多传感协同场景有通用价值。

发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 分布式火灾监测中大量传感设备共享上行链路，目标只是定位有火情证据的区域而非恢复单设备读数，如何高效上报？

方法 TERRA 框架=任务导向本地推理+身份无关区域标记上报+置换不变区域证据聚合；两种上报模式：TERRA-Score（量化本地火灾概率）与 TERRA-Feature（紧凑学习表示，接收端用 DeepSets 聚合）。

关键数字 EN54 数据集 15 种传感模态上，9 份报告且消息完全恢复时 TERRA-Feature 以 24-bit 载荷达 AUPRC 0.990，TERRA-Score 仅 6-bit 达 0.987；FAR≤1% 时 MDR 均为 1.81%。

为什么值得看 任务导向边缘 AI 的典型案例，身份无关+置换不变聚合对多传感协同场景有通用价值。

item.title: TDLM: Adaptive Temporal Integration for Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Masked diffusion language models repeatedly compute representations for unresolved tokens, but conventional denoisers do not explicitly retain these representations for reuse across steps.

Masked diffusion language models repeatedly compute representations for unresolved tokens, but conventional denoisers do not explicitly retain these representations for reuse across steps. We introduce Temporal Self-Conditioning Diffusion Language Model (TDLM), which lets each unresolved position attend to its own history of hidden representations within a frozen denoiser. This gives later predictions access to computation already performed. Training uses self-generated trajectories and a simple cross-entropy objective for tokens revealed between consecutively sampled decoding steps, while causal temporal attention permits parallel evaluation during training. On LLaDA, the temporal modules add only approximately 0.84% trainable parameters. Across LLaDA and Dream, the main comparison shows up to 7.15$\times$ faster generation than the corresponding original diffusion language model, with competitive answer quality on the evaluated tasks. These results motivate temporal memory as a practical way to make more effective use of repeated denoising computation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Agentic 服务在 GPU 集群推理与分布式 CPU 外部工具间交替；现有系统忽略工具返回就绪度（浪费稀缺资源），并用启发式决定准入与 GPU 放置，调度次优。

方法 TAO 工具感知联合调度框架：价值接口融合近期工具就绪度、带时间衰减的节点缓存信用与 token 足迹；动态规划在容量约束下联合选择并放置等待会话。

关键数字 12 组模型-负载-并发设置下，相对各指标最优 SOTA 基线：延迟最高降 26.8%、平均首 token 时间（TTFT）最高降 36.3%、解码吞吐最高增 29.5%。

为什么值得看 把工具执行状态纳入 LLM 服务调度决策，是 agent 场景推理基础设施的一项新思路。
