item.title: Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions.

Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Split Federated Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Split federated learning (SFL) combines partitioned model execution with federated aggregation to support collaborative learning across distributed Web and edge environments.

Split federated learning (SFL) combines partitioned model execution with federated aggregation to support collaborative learning across distributed Web and edge environments. However, removing learned contributions in SFL is challenging due to cross-partition coupling and historical influence propagation through dual-side aggregation. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first systematic formulation of Split Federated Unlearning (SFU), encompassing client-wise and class-wise removal, counterfactual retraining, and partition-specific update constraints. We theoretically characterize historical influence propagation and mode-dependent unlearning feasibility, revealing structural limitations of restricted model updates. As an initial solution, we propose SURE, integrating dual-importance estimation, selective parameter perturbation, and importance-guided recovery. Extensive experiments with existing unlearning methods adapted to SFL reveal substantial forgetting-utility trade-offs across model architectures, data distributions, and update modes. SURE achieves competitive agreement with mode-matched retraining at modest additional cost, while further analyses highlight the impa…

item.title: Sometimes less is more: Investigating inductive biases of MLPs and Transformers on noisy k-parity features
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We empirically investigate how MLPs and Transformers differ when trained on data sets containing one or more features encoded by noisy k-parity.

We empirically investigate how MLPs and Transformers differ when trained on data sets containing one or more features encoded by noisy k-parity. Noisy k-parity gives us hard synthetic data sets in which we can control the predictivity and availability of every feature. Across a range of data distributions, data scales and model sizes, we find large differences in the training dynamics and inductive biases of the two architectures: Transformers are more robust to noisy features but struggle to learn complex, low-availability features, whereas MLPs show the opposite trend and improve steadily with more data. We also find that, under a fixed training budget, increasing the number of unique training examples can slow Transformer optimisation enough to reduce final accuracy, so that a smaller data set performs better. Training-accuracy results show this is an optimisation-speed effect; it shrinks, but does not vanish, when the budget is scaled with the data set size. By giving precise control over feature predictivity and availability, this testbed offers a clear starting point for understanding when and why Transformers and MLPs learn differently, and for designing data and training bu…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

方法 SimplexLoRA：在短预热期内于 n-单纯形上优化每个适配器的重要性权重并冻结，据此动态分配各层秩，不增加总参数预算与推理成本。

为什么值得看 动态秩分配的轻量实现，微调预算受限时收益明确，且代码可直接复用。

item.title: Self-Regularized Flow Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself.

We introduce SERF (Self-Regularized Flow Language Models), a simple self-supervised framework for improving continuous diffusion language models by exploiting the denoising trajectory itself. While continuous flow-based language models offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation, their training objectives typically rely on supervision from clean target tokens, leaving the denoising trajectory underexploited as a learning signal. SERF addresses this limitation through noisy-to-clean self-distillation: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher receives a cleaner version of the student's noisy input along the same interpolation path and provides additional supervision. We investigate two variants: SERF-L, which aligns the student's intermediate representations with deeper teacher representations, and SERF-P, which aligns their output token distributions, either at the student's output or at an early student layer. All variants augment the standard training objective without requiring external pretrained models or modifying the inference procedure. Experiments across three continuous language-model paradigms (one-hot FLM, latent ELF, and hyper-spherical S-FLM) demonstr…

item.title: SLICE-CiM: Selective Layer-wise Inference Control Engine with Confidence-Based Early Exit for SRAM based Digital Compute-in-Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 SRAM 数字存内计算（CIM）宏虽省去片外权重搬运，但其外围控制逻辑引入三类低效：低位宽下的位片过激活（L1）、非必要累加深度（L2）、精度切换空转（L3）。

方法 提出四个可综合外围块：Flush-Merge Enable 控制器、置信度早退模块、精度寄存器+译码器、Bit-Serial 周期控制器，协同最小化开关活动、字线开销与漏电。

关键数字 TSMC 65nm、335MHz 实现，外围面积综合后 1769.760 μm²、PnR 后 1982.131 μm²；总功耗 328.9556 μW（占系统功耗 0.2402%）；MobileNetV2/CIFAR-100 上效率从 31.35 TOPS/W（8b/8b，1.2V）升至 454.91 TOPS/W（2b/8b，0.8V），提升 13.33×，无需改 bitcell 或重训。

为什么值得看 针对 CIM 外围控制逻辑的系统性低功耗优化，量化数据完整，存内计算硬件方向可直接对照。

item.title: SAG-Sep: Sparse Augmented Graphs and Onion-Guided Search for Rounded Capacity Cut Separation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale.

Rounded capacity cuts (RCCs) are among the most effective cuts for capacitated vehicle-routing relaxations, but exact separation is computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing heuristic and neural separators can be fast, but often fail to produce sufficiently many effective cuts within practical separation budgets. We introduce SAG-Sep, a separator that scores node membership in RCC-inducing subsets across vehicle-count levels from a fractional LP solution in a single encoder forward pass, avoiding the iterative predict-and-coarsen inference used by NeuralSEP-style separators. SAG-Sep encodes the LP solution as a Sparse Augmented Graph (SAG), adding flow-informed multi-hop edges that expose long-range routing structure without densifying attention. Beyond LP-aware sparse encoding, we observe that high-value exact RCCs are typically nested, organizing into onion-like subset families, and SAG-Sep's node scores track subset nesting depth. This motivates Onion-Sweep (OS), a training-free decoder that ranks customers by their scores, evaluates the RCC violation of every prefix of the ranking in one vectorized pass, and emits the most violated prefix of each replica together with a cr…

item.title: SAC-GCL: Structure-Aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph.

Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning by maximizing agreement between augmented views of a graph. Although augmented view generation is the central step in GCL, existing models rely on stochastic augmentation of the input graph, such as edge perturbation and node masking, which lack structural awareness and frequently destroy critical topology or introduce semantically inconsistent views. While recent adaptive methods improve upon random perturbations, they primarily operate on localized node or edge neighborhoods and fail to capture higher-order, macro-level structural organization crucial for graph classification. To address this limitation, we propose Structure-aware Compression for Graph Contrastive Learning (SAC-GCL), a novel framework that employs structural decomposition and graph compression as a principled view generation strategy. Moving beyond random augmentations, SAC-GCL leverages structural decomposition techniques to extract cohesive subgraphs and condense them into supernodes, constructing coarsened graph views that preserve local density and capture higher-level structural patterns while reducing…

item.title: Robust LLM Data Selection via Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization.

Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. It then dynamically fuses these attribution signals with semantic representations of the input, combining optimization-level influence with content-level information. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CIGA produces more stable rankings under surface-form perturbations while preserving downstream ca…

Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization.

Gradient-based data attribution has become an important tool for high-quality data selection in the instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs), as it estimates the contribution of training examples through their influence on model optimization. However, we find that existing global gradient attribution methods suffer from surface-form bias: minor changes to semantically irrelevant details, such as wording or formatting, can produce highly inconsistent attribution scores even when the underlying content remains unchanged. To address this issue, we propose Content-Invariant Gradient Attribution (CIGA), a robust framework for instruction data selection. CIGA first identifies layers whose gradients are both influential for attribution and stable under semantics-preserving surface-form perturbations, thereby reducing formatting noise in gradient features. It then dynamically fuses these attribution signals with semantic representations of the input, combining optimization-level influence with content-level information. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CIGA produces more stable rankings under surface-form perturbations while preserving downstream ca…

item.title: Recall or Relearn? A Mixture of In-Context Experts for Recurring Concept Drift
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining.

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are being applied to Web data streams such as network intrusion detection, where they adapt by updating the labelled rows of their context without retraining. When a past concept returns after leaving the context, a TFM faces a recall-or-relearn decision between restoring stored rows of the concept and relearning it from new labels. We propose MICE (Mixture of In-Context Experts), a training-free learner that cuts the stream into segments at detected changes. It merges a closed segment into a stored context when the TFM's estimated additional error on the segment is within a tolerance, under a capacity limit on stored contexts. A fast level weights the stored contexts and first-in-first-out (FIFO) windows by the log-loss of their predictions on the last labelled batch. We show that, with pure stored contexts and a margin condition, this fast level gains over relearning, in expected accuracy, the normalised positive area between the stored context's accuracy and the TFM's learning curve, up to a first-batch term. item.title: RankFormer: Rethinking Time Series Transformers through Representation Capacity Analysis and Progressive Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in Web and cyber-physical systems, where large-scale services and IoT infrastructures generate complex temporal data.

Multivariate time series forecasting plays a critical role in Web and cyber-physical systems, where large-scale services and IoT infrastructures generate complex temporal data. Transformer-based models have achieved strong empirical performance in this domain, yet the principles governing the expressive capacity of their learned representations remain insufficiently understood. Moreover, many existing models rely on simplified decoding strategies, including channel-independent modeling and direct projection heads, which limit their ability to capture complex multivariate dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose RankFormer, a novel encoder-decoder architecture for multivariate time series forecasting. We establish a rank-based analysis framework to investigate how tokenization, embedding, and attention designs affect the representation capacity of time series Transformers. Our analysis reveals that patchification increases the potential representation capacity by aggregating multiple temporal observations into each token, while subsequent encoding operations determine how much of this capacity is realized. item.title: Random Centres and the $\varepsilon$-Dependence of Constant-Round Planar Domination
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

It was recently shown (arXiv:2610.09618) that the infimum of the approximation ratios of deterministic constant-round LOCAL algorithms for minimum dominating set on planar graphs is 7.

It was recently shown (arXiv:2610.09618) that the infimum of the approximation ratios of deterministic constant-round LOCAL algorithms for minimum dominating set on planar graphs is 7. The $(7+\varepsilon)$-approximation given there runs in $T_0+O((c_0/\varepsilon)^κ)$ rounds with $κ=\ln 3/\ln(24/23)\approx 25.81$, and it is asked there whether this exponent can be substantially reduced. We replace the heaviest-edge star selection in its clustering step by a random-centre rule: every part becomes a centre independently with probability $p$, and every non-centre joins its heaviest centre neighbour. For planar graphs this gives $κ<5.89$ with $p=3/8$ (three fair coins per part and level) and $κ<6.7$ with $p=1/2$. An analysis that counts only the join edges cannot go below $5.74$. For every proper minor-closed class of density $a$, the new exponent is never worse, and with about $\frac12\log_2 a$ fair coins per part and level it is smaller by a factor that tends to $8$ as the density grows. This is optimal for the rule when $a$ is an integer and the class contains all $K_{a,n}$. The planar bounds hold verbatim on the torus, the projective plane and the Klein bottle. item.title: Provenance Signatures for Low Rank Adaptations of Image Diffusion Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Diffusion models have revolutionized the generation of realistic artificial images.

Diffusion models have revolutionized the generation of realistic artificial images. Efficient techniques such as Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can modify these models for particular use cases, making them more diverse and widely usable. At the same time, open base models may be adapted to deliver biased, harmful or illegal images in an online service. In this paper, we develop a protocol to detect when a service may be using an adaptation of an otherwise standard model. We describe the precise setup and threat model for this provenance question and define two different problems arising due the presence of multiple model families and multiple adaptations. In contrast to previous works that have considered model identification within lists of known candidate models, we consider the realistic open world scenario where the set of possible adaptations and alternative models are unknown. Using a hypothesis testing approach, our protocols can distinguish between the base model, a LoRA adaptation and other completely different families of models. For this test, we develop a black box signature of the models based only on intrinsic dimension of sets of images generated by the models.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Proposing Better Rollouts for On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model post-training by letting the student learn from its own sampled trajectories under teacher supervision, aligning the training process with inference-time behavior.

On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model post-training by letting the student learn from its own sampled trajectories under teacher supervision, aligning the training process with inference-time behavior. However, the rollout policy in OPD is usually treated as fixed: each round samples directly from the current student. We show that this choice can create a compounding teacher--student mismatch, because it requires the teacher to provide effective supervision on whichever trajectories the student samples, including ones less reachable by the teacher itself. On such trajectories, teacher supervision can become noisy or even misleading, leading to undesirable student patterns such as repetition. Moreover, since the updated student in turn defines the rollout policy of subsequent rounds, these patterns persist and potentially amplify over training. This failure mode suggests that improving OPD requires treating the rollout policy itself as an optimization target, rather than only modifying the distillation objective. We propose Mixture Proposal On-Policy Distillation (MPOPD), which derives a student-anchored, teacher-guided rollout distribution from a local trust-region o…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PL)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Program specifications in separation logic describe ownership of resources and serve as logical interfaces for local reasoning.

Program specifications in separation logic describe ownership of resources and serve as logical interfaces for local reasoning. Compiler correctness, expressed as semantics preservation, does not by itself supply such an interface for compiled code, because it does not explicitly relate source and target resources and assertions. We investigate WP-preserving compilation: when a compiler translates a source program, the weakest preconditions that the program satisfies in a separation logic carry over to the compiled program. Our proof technique consists of a resource-aware simulation over interaction trees: it relates the resources required by corresponding source and target events, and tracks ownership through target operations, such as register accesses, that have no source counterpart. We apply the approach to a compiler from a structured imperative language to an assembly-like language, first for closed programs and then extended with modules and function calls. In the extended setting, each module can be verified in the source logic and compiled separately; its specifications carry over to the compiled module and are preserved when compiled modules are linked. item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Benign fine-tuning can erode safety alignment in large language models, and sequential adaptation substantially compounds this risk.

Benign fine-tuning can erode safety alignment in large language models, and sequential adaptation substantially compounds this risk. Prior work mitigates this erosion by replaying harmful-prompt refusals and benign-compliance examples, while other work instead matches base-model logits via distillation. However, the individual contributions of supervised exposure and distillation to safety behavior and refusal geometry during sequential adaptation remain unclear. We factor these two strategies apart and study their behavioral and geometric effects during sequential LoRA fine-tuning of Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B across diverse task sequences (code generation, German-language summarization, and science question-answering). Behaviorally, supervised replay exposure yields the largest reduction in HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) on Mistral, averaging 51.1 points below base, but at a substantial over-refusal cost, averaging 53.4 points above base on OR-Bench-hard. Logit distillation, without any supervised replay loss, largely prevents safety erosion at a fraction of this cost: an average 5.4-point ASR reduction against only a 5.1-point rise in over-refusal. Full-order surrogates for high-dimensional nonlinear flows are often unnecessary when applications require only selected degrees of freedom. We propose reduced-order models that bypass full-state reconstruction by deploying graph neural networks (GNNs) directly on coarse meshes. Applied to parameterized 2D/3D confined cylinder flows and an unevenly heated cavity over Reynolds/Rayleigh-number ranges, the models generalize to unseen conditions and accurately predict sparse probe locations and integrated quantities. Coarse-mesh GNNs match or outperform finer-mesh surrogates while reducing training time and memory, even for 3D chaotic dynamics. Coarse-mesh training also makes noise-augmented multi-step unrolling practical, improving long-horizon autoregressive predictions. item.title: Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization.

In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. item.description:

Predictive maintenance is vital for commercial aviation, yet progress remains hindered by the lack of public, large-scale real-world datasets.

Predictive maintenance is vital for commercial aviation, yet progress remains hindered by the lack of public, large-scale real-world datasets. As a result, most methods are developed and evaluated on proprietary data, limiting reproducibility. We introduce Pneuma, the first publicly available large-scale benchmark for predictive maintenance using onboard time series from in-service commercial aircraft. Built around bleed air systems, Pneuma contains over 920 million multivariate time steps across four aircraft types and 9 verified fault scenarios, directly aligned with real maintenance logs. The dataset exhibits key real-world challenges, including substantial class imbalance, subtle fault evolution patterns, and significant variance across aircraft configurations. We structure the benchmark around three tasks: multivariate forecasting, supervised fault classification, and unsupervised anomaly detection, with labels derived from actual maintenance records. Under unified settings, we evaluate over 25 models from four methodological families on 9 carefully curated subsets. As a result, most methods are developed and evaluated on proprietary data, limiting reproducibility. We introduce Pneuma, the first publicly available large-scale benchmark for predictive maintenance using onboard time series from in-service commercial aircraft. Built around bleed air systems, Pneuma contains over 920 million multivariate time steps across four aircraft types and 9 verified fault scenarios, directly aligned with real maintenance logs. The dataset exhibits key real-world challenges, including substantial class imbalance, subtle fault evolution patterns, and significant variance across aircraft configurations. We structure the benchmark around three tasks: multivariate forecasting, supervised fault classification, and unsupervised anomaly detection, with labels derived from actual maintenance records. Under unified settings, we evaluate over 25 models from four methodological families on 9 carefully curated subsets. The results reveal that even strong contemporary models struggle with subtle fault signatures. Further analyses …

item.title: PipeLink: Contract-Guided Linking of GPU Kernel Components
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 最快的 ML kernel 是 loader、GEMM 主循环、epilogue、通信阶段等组件的组合，但组件硬编码其在共享 SM 空间中的位置，无法独立编译、分发或替换，跨来源组合只能手工 fork。

方法 PipeLink 契约引导链接器：每个组件独立编译为携带资源契约（需求+承诺）的 LTO 对象；PipeLink 检查契约互容、联合求解 SM 资源的一次性放置、生成组件间传输，vendor LTO 后端将结果折为常量。

关键数字 Hopper/Blackwell 上 51 组配置链接后的 kernel 与整体编译差距在 0.2% 以内；CuTe attention 算子嵌入 ThunderKittens decode megakernel 使解码提速 2.16×；GEMM+SwiGLU 组合在 Blackwell 上比 cuBLAS 快 1.2×。

为什么值得看 让 kernel 组件像软件一样可组合替换而不损失性能，对 kernel 库与推理系统开发者非常实用。

item.title: PRISM: Pathology Reliability In Scarce-label Medicine. A Tile-level Benchmark of Pathology Foundation Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and r

Pathology foundation models are typically benchmarked on classification performance at full label availability and on in-distribution test sets, while calibration, behavior at low label budgets, and robustness under cross-institutional shift are seldom evaluated jointly. We introduce PRISM, a tile-level benchmark that measures the reliability of pathology foundation models along four axes: model choice, label fraction, calibration, and out-of-distribution transfer. PRISM evaluates eight foundation models (CLIP, PLIP, CONCH, UNI, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-0, Midnight) on six tile-level datasets at six label fractions (1% to 100%) with three seeds (864 linear probe runs), extended with a five-hospital Camelyon17 study of 20 directed transfer pairs. Four phenomena emerge. (i) Under full supervision, AUROC rank predicts post-temperature calibration rank consistently across datasets (Spearman rho = 0.52, I^2 = 0%), whereas at 1% labels the relationship becomes dataset-specific (rho = -0.24, I^2 = 67%). item.title: Orthogonal and Parametrized Multi-Attribute Steering of LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Activation steering offers an effective and efficient way to modify an LLM's behavior at inference time.

Activation steering offers an effective and efficient way to modify an LLM's behavior at inference time. However, it remains unclear how to apply steering such that the signal is consistently strong and the steering strength has a universally interpretable meaning. We address this first by identifying the most steerable interval for each steering vector and rescaling the steering range accordingly. Building on this, we introduce a more interpretable method for steering, called parameterized steering which instead of pushing activations in a direction, it sets them at the desired trait strength. Next, with multi-trait steering, we find that naively combining vectors causes them to interfere with one another. In response, we develop a method to orthogonalize the vectors; it decouples these traits, allowing a model to exhibit one behavior without inducing the others, thus enabling multiple traits to be steered simultaneously.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: On the Sparsity of Direct Preference Optimization: Weight Disentanglement in the NTK Regime
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has been widely adopted for aligning language models with human preferences.

Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has been widely adopted for aligning language models with human preferences. Recent empirical work has revealed that DPO induces remarkably sparse parameter updates, yet no theoretical explanation for this phenomenon has been offered. We analyze DPO's optimization dynamics under a neural tangent kernel linearization and show that the logistic structure of the DPO loss gives rise to an implicit maximum-margin bias. Building on this observation, we introduce the concept of dual sparsity: the DPO update direction is a sparse linear combination (data-level sparsity, driven by support vectors) of sparse gradient feature vectors (parameter-level sparsity, arising from gradient cancellation between preferred and dispreferred responses). We formalize this structure in our main theorem, bound the number of support pairs by a margin-dependent spectral quantity, and present a framework relating dual sparsity to weight disentanglement---a condition favorable for model merging. Experiments on GPT-2 Small and Medium and on 7--9B instruction-tuned models (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B) with the Anthropic HH-RLHF and UltraFeedback datasets confirm both sou…

item.title: Normalized Cuts and Data Clustering via Matrix Fractional Programming
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

The normalized cut (NCut) problem is a fundamental one in the area of data clustering.

The normalized cut (NCut) problem is a fundamental one in the area of data clustering. Despite its fractional structure, the NCut problem is seldom considered from a fractional programming (FP) perspective in the existing literature. The main reason is that the conventional FP method is inadequate for this problem case: the classical Dinkelbach's transform can only handle a single ratio and hence is limited to the two-class clustering, whereas the multi-class clustering involves multiple ratio terms. This work proposes a novel so-called multidimensional quadratic transform that is capable of dealing with the multi-ratio case; it recasts the NCut problem into a bipartite matching problem---which can be immediately solved by linear search. Furthermore, we explore the connection between the proposed FP method and the minorization-maximization (MM) theory, and in turn characterize the convergence behavior of our algorithm. Finally, we conduct experiments to numerically demonstrate the advantages of the proposed FP-based algorithm in a variety of data clustering and image segmentation tasks.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain.

Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. Using observations and tool feedback, the LLM agent selects tools, configures their parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget, while numerical methods compute and evaluate candidate points. Building on this system, we also introduce NextEval Bench, a benchmark protocol for comparing…

item.title: MuonGS: Pretraining LLMs with Relaxed Weight-Norm Control
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Weight decay and explicit weight-norm constraints improve optimizer performance in language model pretraining, yet a unified understanding of why such control helps and how much is needed remains incomplete.

Weight decay and explicit weight-norm constraints improve optimizer performance in language model pretraining, yet a unified understanding of why such control helps and how much is needed remains incomplete. We analyze norm control in Muon over the entire training trajectory using the \emph{accumulated effective learning rate}, $C_T=\sum_{t<T}η_t/\|W_t\|_F$, where $η_t$ is the nominal learning rate and $η_t/\|W_t\|_F$ is the effective learning rate relative to the weight norm. For bounded update directions, accumulation over any training interval bounds relative weight displacement. We show that vanilla Muon can accumulate only logarithmically, potentially limiting exploration and helping explain its slower empirical progress, whereas MuonW and MuonH guarantee at least linear accumulation under the stated conditions. Going beyond bounded-norm control, we show that sufficiently slow norm growth guarantees faster accumulation than the logarithmic worst case, opening up less restrictive optimizer designs. Based on this insight, we propose MuonGS, which uses Gram--Schmidt (GS) projection to remove the radial component of each Muon update without fixing the weight norm. With bounded upd…

item.title: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW.

Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loa…

item.title: Mechanistic Failure Modes of Weight Pruning in Transformer Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 剪枝后的语言模型几乎只用准确率与困惑度评估，隐含假设"输出行为保留=内部计算保留"；该假设是否成立缺乏机制级检验。

方法 在 GPT-2 上做因子化剪枝研究：交叉 2 种重要性准则（幅值/随机）×2 类组件（注意力头/MLP 神经元）×3 档稀疏度（3%/50%/70%），以已完整刻画的 IOI 电路为 ground truth，用激活修补、路径修补与直接 logit 归因测量电路完整性。

关键数字 幅值头剪枝使电路归零、模型跌至接近随机；幅值神经元剪枝在 30% 时反转——26 个电路头全部完好但 Name Mover 贡献翻转符号，模型系统性选错名字（准确率 17.7%），而困惑度 74.6 反而显示损伤小于随机头剪枝（140.1）。

为什么值得看 实证表明输出指标与结构检查都可能漏掉机制性损伤，为压缩模型评估补充了电路级因果分析视角。

item.description:

Context: Non-determinism in deep learning algorithm design and implementation leads to performance variation, meaning model performance is not a single value, but rather a distribution.

Context: Non-determinism in deep learning algorithm design and implementation leads to performance variation, meaning model performance is not a single value, but rather a distribution. These model performance distributions are underexplored despite their impact on robustness. Objective: We investigate the robustness of deep learning performance to sources of non-determinism, specifically focusing on how performance distributions differ across various architectures and tasks. Method: We conducted 186 experiments on image classification and time series forecasting architectures. Each experiment was run 100 times with different random seeds to generate performance distributions, resulting in 18,600 runs. Robustness was quantified using metrics for spread, symmetry, and tail risk. Results: Performance distributions are frequently non-Gaussian, particularly in time series forecasting. Model size does not systematically affect robustness -- larger image classification models show fewer outliers but not lower spread, while smaller time series models show lower spread but more extreme underperformers. item.title: MM-Net: A Multimodal Multi-Task Network for Sleep Staging and Sleep Apnea Assessment After Ischemic Stroke
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances.

Automated polysomnography after ischemic stroke is challenging because of altered sleep-related neural activity and concurrent respiratory disturbances. Existing stroke-specific approaches mainly address sleep-stage classification, leaving joint analysis of sleep architecture and respiratory events underexplored. Moreover, adapting pretrained EEG encoders introduces a representation inconsistency when downstream models are trained on embeddings from previously seen patients but evaluated on unseen individuals. We propose MM-Net, a multimodal multi-task framework that resolves this inconsistency through cross-fitting and ridge-based embedding alignment. item.title: Live-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Proactive Streaming Large Video Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Streaming multimodal assistants must make response decisions while events are still unfolding.

Streaming multimodal assistants must make response decisions while events are still unfolding. They need to recognize when the available evidence warrants a response, produce an appropriate continuation, and remain silent otherwise. Supervised fine-tuning learns from recorded assistant turns, but does not directly train on the response prefixes produced by the evolving policy itself. We introduce Live-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation method that uses privileged hints available only during training to supervise the policy on its own outputs. The policy first generates a continuation from the streaming context alone. The same model then re-evaluates that continuation with a hint describing the relevant evidence, and the resulting distributions guide the unhinted policy. On Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, Live-OPSD attains an average score of 59.64 on LiveProBench, 5.26 points above the strongest continued-SFT baseline, and stays competitive on OVO-Bench (65.84). These results indicate that guiding the policy on its own outputs with privileged hints improves both when and how a streaming assistant responds.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Less is more: learning what to profile for GPU kernel optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 自动优化 GPU kernel 的效果取决于可用硬件信息；现有系统用预定义 profile 策略，把"该采集什么"排除在优化之外——更多指标一定更好吗？

方法 证明采集更多指标不单调提升优化效果，最有用的信息因 kernel 而异；理论分析表明异质 profile 效用下 kernel 条件化选择可胜过任何单一固定配置；AutoProfiler 从优化反馈学习确定性 profile 树（REWRITE/SPLIT 迭代精化）。

关键数字 KernelBench 上受约束 profile 预算下优于固定配置；树构建完成后任意 kernel 快速取 profile、LLM 重写器只调用一次。

为什么值得看 把"profile 什么"本身变成可学习维度，kernel 优化系统设计新视角。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Time-series data generated by Web services and connected systems support applications such as user activity analysis, service monitoring, and resource management.

Time-series data generated by Web services and connected systems support applications such as user activity analysis, service monitoring, and resource management. However, learning transferable representations from heterogeneous time series remains challenging due to diverse temporal patterns, variable sequence lengths, and limited high-quality annotations. Despite the success of pre-training in natural language processing and computer vision, effective time-series pre-training requires strategies tailored to temporal data. We propose TimeHAT (Hybrid Attention Transformer), a general-purpose pre-training framework for time-series analysis that addresses two complementary questions: what to learn and how to learn. For what to learn, we introduce a Unified Point-Patch Masking Strategy (UPPMS) that integrates point-level and patch-level supervision within a unified framework for contextual reconstruction and causal extrapolation, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained temporal variations and broader temporal patterns. item.title: LLM knowledge for improved Out-of-Distribution Tabular Prediction - A Cross-Validated Regularisation Approach
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer.

Prediction models degrade when the deployment population differs from the one used to train them, and training data cannot say which feature-response relationships will transfer. Expert elicitation is slow and unscalable. We ask whether coefficient priors elicited from large language models (LLMs) improve out-of-distribution (OOD) prediction as the shrinkage target of a regularised regression instead of zero, across five tabular datasets split on real covariates, selecting providers and prior structures by source-domain cross-validation alone. The priors help on four of five datasets, by up to 7.9% OOD mean squared error, and ten of twenty-four prior-informed results resolve the mean improvement at conventional confidence; single-deployment intervals are much wider. On classification the gain is in probabilistic accuracy, not ranking, and control tests with corrupted priors attribute the benefit to feature-specific content rather than scale. Two findings temper this. Variation across candidate priors exceeds the average benefit, yet cross-validation margins fall below their own noise, so selection avoids the worst prior rather than finding the best. item.title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation.

We present LCM-Promo, an LLM-based uplift model for promotion allocation. LCM-Promo is a task-specific Large Commerce Model (LCM): a finetuned LLM trained on transactional commerce data to predict user intent and promotion response. It learns monotonic promotion-response curves from production logs by interpreting single-token outputs as conversion-threshold probabilities, while conditioning on session context such as day and delivery shift. In a production A/B test on churn reactivation, LCM-Promo increased conversion by 1% and reduced promotion cost by 6% relative to the Segment-EMA production baseline.

item.title: Kernel Performance Engineering under Physical Non-Idealities
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 IC 设计与制造中的物理非理想性被传统硬件抽象掩盖，却可能限制 kernel 性能并遮蔽优化机会——如何量化并利用这些约束？

方法 以 NVIDIA H100 DSMEM 为案例：floorsweeping 限制集群执行可用资源，可能抵消 DSMEM 减少数据搬运的收益；据此提出波感知聚类策略；TDP 限制下数据搬运减少经 DVFS 允许更高 SM 频率。

关键数字 波感知聚类使 FlashAttention 4（Hopper）吞吐较基线最高 +5.30%；全局加载广播微基准与 GEMM 亦验证；功耗约束同样限制 Tenstorrent Wormhole 吞吐扩展。

为什么值得看 把"物理非理想性"纳入 kernel 性能分析，对 DSMEM 类新硬件优化有普适启发。

item.title: JustGoal: With Only a Goal, the AI Baseline Is Above the Expert Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高性能 GPU kernel 开发依赖专家知识、专用 agent 与领域工作流——随基础模型变强，这些专门机制还剩多少价值？

方法 JustGoal 基线：通用 agent 只拿到优化目标与约束，无 kernel 专属基础设施/知识库/预定义工作流，自行构建评估闭环。

关键数字 NVIDIA B200 上 10 算子中 8 个超开源库，逐算子几何平均加速 1.14x–2.34x；9 个可比算子中 5 个超最快公开专用-agent kernel；同模型对比（Fable 5.1）KDA-0.5 达 JustGoal 的 0.95x，消融显示领域知识与预定义工作流无一致收益。

为什么值得看 用"仅目标"基线给 kernel 优化专门机制设标尺：收益不明显就不该加复杂机制。

item.title: How Many and How Much? Contrastive Learning with Negative Samples for Knowledge Graph Embedding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Knowledge graph embedding (KGE), a fundamental technique for knowledge-centric Web and KG-augmented AI applications, is commonly trained through contrastive learning with negative samples to learn discriminative representations.

Knowledge graph embedding (KGE), a fundamental technique for knowledge-centric Web and KG-augmented AI applications, is commonly trained through contrastive learning with negative samples to learn discriminative representations. Despite its empirical success, two crucial questions regarding negative samples remain underexplored: (Q1) how many negative samples should be used for each positive sample and (Q2) how much should each negative sample contribute to learning? To answer these questions, we propose RADAR, a novel contrastive learning framework for KGE models with two effective strategies, respectively: (1) Risk-aware negative budget allocation quantifies false-negative sampling risk by modeling an open-world KG as a stochastic partial observation of its closed-world counterpart and adaptively assigns a negative budget to each positive sample based on its risk; (2) Distribution-calibrated negative weighting assigns negative weights by calibrating the weighting strength for each positive based on two complementary characteristics of the negative-score distribution: dispersion and concentration. Stationary tail computation for high-dimensional reflected Brownian motions (RBMs) remains computationally challenging. Building on NN4MGF's shared-coordinate basic-adjoint-relationship (BAR) framework, we develop Holomorphic Cauchy Networks (HCNs). Native complex-valued rational Cauchy subnetworks enforce holomorphicity on pole-free domains, removing sampled Cauchy-Riemann penalties and their input-derivative graphs. item.title: HiLo-RD: Cross-Budget Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget.

We propose HiLo-RD (High-to-Low Budget Representation Distillation) to improve masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) under a limited generation budget. Unlike autoregressive models, MDLMs choose both what to generate and where to commit it. This creates two coupled challenges: predicting useful content before reasoning is complete, and deciding when to fix answer tokens that shape later predictions. We identify budget-induced premature commitment: even when a correct solution fits, the model can fix answer fragments near the window boundary before resolving intermediate steps. These fragments become context for later predictions and redirect subsequent reasoning. Existing post-training methods do not directly transfer the stronger trajectories that the same model follows with a larger window. HiLo-RD addresses this gap by (1) pairing large-window teacher states with cropped small-window views and (2) matching their hidden representations at committed positions. This supervision guides both token prediction and commitment order without an external teacher. Across mathematics benchmarks, HiLo-RD improves low-budget accuracy and shortens responses; these gains extend to code genera…

item.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates.

We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups,…

We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates.

We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups,…

item.title: Hardware-Matched Spiking Neural Networks for Real-Time Purkinje Cell Spike Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 研究浦肯野细胞功能需区分简单/复杂 spike；无线头戴因功率预算无法连续传输原始记录——能否在受限硬件上实时完成 spike 分类？

方法 两个与硬件匹配的紧凑 SNN：ConvSNN 映射到 EFM32PG28 微控制器矩阵向量处理器（MVP），StreamSNN 用学习时间常数与固定突触延迟逐时间步处理波形（面向专用 SKY130 电路）。

关键数字 未见细胞上：ConvSNN CS F1=0.873（1018 参数）、StreamSNN 0.837（527 参数），均 8-bit；MVP 使 ConvSNN 延迟降 62.3%、50mAh 电池续航估 33.73 小时；SKY130 上 StreamSNN 0.173mm²、每事件 0.46μJ。

为什么值得看 从算法到 MCU/ASIC 全栈匹配的神经科学边缘计算案例，功耗数字具体。

item.title: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

AI agents have made substantial progress in domains where they have a non-trivial amount of time to deliberate between actions, such as mathematics, software engineering, and performing tasks on desktop applications.

AI agents have made substantial progress in domains where they have a non-trivial amount of time to deliberate between actions, such as mathematics, software engineering, and performing tasks on desktop applications. It is less clear how such models fare in settings that demand real-time interaction, such as playing a video game or operating a physical device. In these settings, the environment state may evolve as the agent is reasoning, or even as the underlying model is performing a forward pass. To gain insight into the real-time interaction capabilities of vision-language agents, we introduce Gym-Anything-RT. Our key idea is to construct visual minigames that demand a portfolio of capabilities required for interactive real-time settings. Gym-Anything-RT uses an agentic pipeline to automatically generate such environments based on a taxonomy of six capabilities required for real-time interaction, including the ability to perceive the environment and act under an evolving environment state. A key feature of Gym-Anything-RT is that it allows for controlled comparison of real-time interaction capabilities: we can run the same minigame in real time, or pause or slow down the environ…

item.title: Generative modeling for fusion: a large-scale benchmark of stellarator fast-ion simulations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Stellarators offer a promising magnetic confinement approach for achieving controlled nuclear fusion.

Stellarators offer a promising magnetic confinement approach for achieving controlled nuclear fusion. However, stellarator design remains challenging, as evaluating configuration performance requires computationally expensive, high-fidelity simulations. In particular, key performance metrics derived from guiding center simulations are costly to include directly in the design optimization loop, and are almost exclusively used as diagnostics. Machine learning has the potential to advance fusion research by enabling rapid generation and evaluation of new stellarator configurations. Effectively applying ML for fusion demands large-scale datasets that capture both design diversity and high-fidelity simulation outputs. In this work, we introduce the Benchmark of Stellarator Simulations (BoSS), a dataset of stellarator designs paired with guiding center simulation results and trajectories. The BoSS is the first large-scale dataset of guiding center simulations, containing simulation data for 180,000 distinct magnetohydrodynamic equilibria spanning a wide range of magnetic geometries and confinement properties. To exemplify the utility of ML to accelerate stellarator design, we formulate a…

item.title: Generative Replay for Equilibrium Propagation: Toward Edge-Friendly Continual Learning in Hopfield Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 均衡传播（EqProp）是 Hopfield 网络训练的生物合理替代，但其持续学习行为未被探索——能否不依赖外部数据缓冲或架构开销克服灾难性遗忘？

方法 EB-Gen 基于能量的生成式重放：利用 Hopfield 网络内在生成动力学，同一模型既当分类器又当重放样本生成器；冻结网络副本经松弛生成捕获过往知识的伪数据用于排练。

关键数字 类增量设置：Split MNIST 平均精度 75%、Split CIFAR10 64%；对比 FineTune、Experience Replay、Generative Replay、SRC、Joint training，显著提升稳定性同时保留可塑性。

为什么值得看 用网络自身生成动力学替代外部重放缓冲，边缘友好的持续学习路线。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Self-attention mechanisms have established the Transformer as the dominant backbone across natural language processing, source code intelligence, and automated theorem proving.

Self-attention mechanisms have established the Transformer as the dominant backbone across natural language processing, source code intelligence, and automated theorem proving. However, all-to-all pairwise token comparison enforces a quadratic $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ compute and memory barrier alongside severe softmax attention dilution as sequence length $N$ scales beyond the training horizon. Inspired by recent advances in algebraic graph learning (\textbf{WPNet}), this work introduces \textbf{GTFormer}, a syntax-free hierarchical Graph Neural Network (GNN) that replaces flat self-attention for general long-context sequence modeling. GTFormer organizes raw token streams into a bounded-degree hierarchy combining a balanced binary reduction tree ($\lceil \log_2 N \rceil$ depth), horizontal boundary-bridging shift edges, random expander shortcuts, multi-channel convex highway gating, and a top-down broadcast pass. item.title: GNN-Guided Network Reduction for Centralized Urban Traffic Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We consider the centralized traffic routing (CTR) problem, where a central planner assigns routes to origin-destination (OD) vehicle flows to minimize congestion-dependent segment cost.

We consider the centralized traffic routing (CTR) problem, where a central planner assigns routes to origin-destination (OD) vehicle flows to minimize congestion-dependent segment cost. Prior work formulates CTR efficiently as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), but scaling this formulation to the full road network is computationally prohibitive within an operational time budget. Bounded Routes and Smart Routes speed up optimization using precomputed reduced networks; however, these methods do not account for vehicle information within each OD flow. Motivated by this gap, we propose a learning-based urban network reduction approach. A dedicated graph neural network (GNN) first scores road segments for each OD flow using the road network and vehicle-flow information. Highly ranked segments are then incorporated into complete OD routes, and the original segment-flow MILP is solved on the resulting reduced road network. The GNN thus guides the reduction of the road network, while the solver enforces feasibility and determines the routing. Experiments on four real urban networks -- Prague-Dejvice, London, New York, and Sydney -- show that the proposed approach achieves the smallest …

item.title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Attention Matching（AM）压缩 KV 缓存需给保留 key 的 logit 加偏置，但 FlashAttention 与 vLLM 分页缓存没有该输入——压缩缓存能否直接在标准 kernel 上跑？

方法 把偏置沿每头一个闭式方向（在上下文 query 上拟合）折叠进 key，得到尺寸与 AM 相同、走模型自身 query 路径的普通缓存；输出误差以 query 在该方向投影与 1 的距离为上界。

关键数字 等预算下未修改 vLLM 服务折叠缓存：Qwen3-4B 全部 51 问与 HF 一致、LongBench 200 样本中 180 个贪心输出一致；14 组设置中 13 组精度与 AM 噪声内，12 组可比 KL 全部低于丢弃偏置。

为什么值得看 闭式变换让压缩缓存兼容标准推理栈，免自定义 kernel。

item.title: Finite-Step Geometry of Marginal-Preserving Velocity Fields in Generative Flows
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization.

Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization. We study this finite-step non-equivalence while keeping the marginal path and numerical method fixed. Projected modified equations characterize the component of local integration error that changes the marginal law and give sufficient conditions for higher marginal convergence order. For affine fixed-shape distributions, we characterize exact finite-step reachability and derive spectral obstructions and sharp nearest-reachable Wasserstein errors. For diffusion probability-flow ODEs, we construct skew-score perturbations that preserve the exact marginal path under exact scores and quantify their leakage under score error. Controlled Gaussian and mixture experiments recover the predicted order, reachability, and obstruction phenomena.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:

As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive.

As executable environments for language agents scale, generating and verifying their rollouts becomes increasingly expensive. Under finite rollout budgets, this raises an important question: can data management at the environment level make agentic reinforcement learning (RL) more efficient by organizing, evaluating, and scheduling task instances together with the environments that determine their tools, states, transitions, and verification? To address this question, we introduce EnvSched (Environment-aware Scheduling), an online scheduler that learns from rollout history. EnvSched assigns scheduling value through two complementary modeling choices: exploitation prioritizes tasks likely to provide informative reward differences, while coverage spreads each batch across underobserved environments and interaction patterns. EnvSched organizes environment--task pairs as nodes in a dual-relation graph, with within-environment edges capturing task semantics and shared tool, state, and verifier structure, and cross-environment edges capturing abstract execution and reward topology. By propagating historical rollout statistics along both edge types, it predicts within-task reward variance…

item.title: EnergyCal: Taming Loss Spikes in Muon-Family Optimizers for Sparse MoE Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers.

Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language-model training can exhibit large loss spikes with Muon-family optimizers. We introduce EnergyCal, a lightweight rule that attenuates routed-expert updates according to the normalized squared Frobenius norm of their finite-step Newton-Schulz directions. EnergyCal leaves the spectral transform unchanged and adds no persistent optimizer state. We evaluate it on a 4B-parameter MoE model. Against a development-selected, lower-learning-rate MuonH recipe, EnergyCal-MuonH reduces mean thresholded loss-spike burden by 99.51% and final geometric-mean perplexity by 4.06%, with a modest throughput cost. With plain Muon at matched nominal learning rate and weight decay, the reduction in mean spike burden averages 95.98% across the two tested exponents, accompanied by small endpoint improvements. These findings support stabilization both with and without Hyperball in the evaluated setting.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space.

We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

item.title: Efficient Quantization Training with Stochastic Rounding via Structured Subspace Randomness
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低精度训练靠随机舍入（SR）保持梯度无偏；但向量单元吞吐远落后矩阵单元，逐元素独立随机阈值会饱和向量单元、使 INT8+SR 比 BF16 更慢——能否消除该开销？

方法 S3R：每个上游梯度只量化一次供激活与权重梯度两个矩阵乘法共用，跨隐藏维每 token 共享单一阈值；S3R-EC 从两路梯度减去结构化平均舍入误差。关键：共享阈值引入的公共偏移主要经激活梯度向后层传播，须在起源层消除。

关键数字 TPU v5p 上全 INT8 训练步比 BF16 快 1.24x–1.32x、比独立 SR 快 1.11x；验证损失与独立 SR 持平。

为什么值得看 把随机舍入成本从"逐元素"降到"每 token 一次"，INT8 训练实用化关键一步。

item.title: EdgePace: Deadline- and Freshness-Aware LLM Scheduling on Unified-Memory Platforms
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 边缘设备上 LLM 与传感器任务共享统一内存：即使计算空闲，LLM 推理也会经带宽争用延迟前台任务——如何既保护前台截止期又维持 LLM 反馈时效？

方法 EdgePace 带宽感知运行时：在 prefill/decode 间建立安全挂起点，低成本监测前台内存需求与停顿，按争用风险/截止期松弛/输出新鲜度调度推理。

关键数字 OnePlus 13 与三款 NVIDIA Jetson（多相机+机器人目标跟踪）：前台截止期错过率降 24.1%–96.1%，保留 64.9%–98.5% LLM 吞吐；全部输出落在新鲜度窗口；OnePlus 13 相机截止期错过降 91.3%、保留 90.4% 吞吐。

为什么值得看 带宽感知调度的完整运行时，实时边缘场景 LLM 与传感器共存的直接方案。

item.title: Does LLM Pre-Training Typically Occur at the Edge of Stability?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization, but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity.

Quadratic approximations provide a common lens for studying neural network optimization, but recent evidence challenges their predictive validity. In full-batch gradient descent with learning rate (LR) $η$, Cohen et al. (2021) observed the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the largest Hessian eigenvalue concentrates near $2/η$, seemingly at odds with classical stability conditions predicted by quadratic approximations. In this work, we revisit the fidelity of quadratic approximations as a model of neural network training dynamics, with a particular focus on their failure modes in LLM training. We first highlight a distinct failure mode of the quadratic approximation, where persistent negative curvature causes the quadratic dynamics to diverge regardless of the LR, even though the real dynamics remain stable. We term this phenomenon the Edge of Convexity (EoC). After removing the effect of this LR-independent instability, we then propose a generalized definition of Edge of Stability (EoS) for stochastic training with adaptive optimizers, based on whether increasing the LR induces significant divergence in the quadratic dynamics while leaving the real dynamics largely unchanged. item.title: Depth through Recurrence: Towards Ultra-Efficient On-Device ASR
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 手表、眼镜等端侧设备资源极度受限，深度 ASR 大模型无法部署——能否不扩大参数量就获得深度模型的表示能力？

方法 观察到多数层学到功能相似的变换，据此提出块循环（block-recurrent）ASR 架构：用少量权值共享的循环块替代参数化深度，配合表示引导分组与知识蒸馏压缩模型；再以轻量 MoE-LoRA 实现端侧个性化。

关键数字 仅两个共享块的模型平均恢复大模型 97.4% 的精度，参数量少一个数量级；权值复用降低访存开销与推理能耗。

为什么值得看 面向手表/眼镜等超受限设备的 ASR 压缩路线，循环深度+蒸馏+MoE-LoRA 组合，对端侧语音算法（含 KWS 相关方向）很有参考价值。

item.title: DeepInfer-Mac: Running a 750B-Class MoE on a 24 GB Laptop
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 模型远大于内存时能否在本地笔记本运行？存储读等待成为每 token 生成的主要延迟——如何组织权重读入与缓存？

方法 DeepInfer-Mac 在 24GB 统一内存 MacBook Air 上运行 750B 级 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash：混合低比特转换占 SSD 338GiB，约 7.6GiB 权重常驻，路由专家与 Engram 行按需加载；专家权重按"直接填满可复用 GPU buffer"组织，缓存分配与 buffer 生命周期耦合。

关键数字 中英代码生成 0.21–0.72 tok/s，最大进程足迹 16.73GiB；下一层预取较仅常驻专家重叠吞吐 +21.0%；长 prompt 仍昂贵。

为什么值得看 把"750B 跑在 24GB 笔记本"的操作点边界讲透：可运行，但存储与 prefill 主导等待。

item.title: DFIP: Decision-Focused Inference Path for System One Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.PF)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 System One 决策模型返回小而结构化答案，但仍保留 host 分发、GPU 启动与全词表投影开销——既有推理技术在决策模型上值多少？

方法 DFIP 实证研究：在 PPLX-Decider、Liquid d1-3B、Clef-Flash、GLiNER2.5-Decide 上施加选择性 CUDA graph 重放、候选 token 投影、长度感知批处理，与更强原生基线对比并审计输出。

关键数字 装 Qwen 原生 kernel 后：Decider 短布尔驻留请求加速 2.47x（五容器）、Clef 1.45x（四容器）；GLiNER 长度感知批处理比原生 FIFO 快 1.40x 但到达 p95 更差；审计保留全部 1,112 个选择。

为什么值得看 不宣称万能加速，老实给出各技术的适用边界与失效场景。

item.title: DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 混合 LLM 只在少数全注意力层保留 KV 缓存，但该缓存随 prompt 增长、复用需存储或搬运——能否学习端到端可训练的 KV 缓存编解码器？

方法 DCKV 可微编解码器（首个端到端训练的 KV 缓存 codec）：变换、量化与熵模型（以 prompt token 与已解码邻近位置为条件）与冻结语言模型联合优化，同时最小化熵模型码长与模型输出变化。

关键数字 Qwen3.5-2B：压缩 token 比 bf16 少 55 倍以上字节（三个长上下文基准损失 ≤1.8 分）；100 倍以上压缩时损失 ≤3.6 分。

为什么值得看 KV 缓存压缩做成可微端到端学习的首个工作，压缩率显著。

item.title: ConfluxServe: Reconciling Resource Utilization and Parallelism Efficiency across Prefill and Decode in LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.DC)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 服务中 prefill 与 decode 资源互补但并行偏好相异：分离执行保并行度却浪费互补资源，共批处理提利用率又受统一并行配置拖累。

方法 提出 Conflux Parallelism（XP）抽象，在同一 batch 内以不同并行度共执行 prefill 与 decode，利用算子级 Transformer 结构构建异构执行路径；其上构建 SLO 感知的 ConfluxServe 系统，在 TTFT/TBT 约束下最大化集群 goodput。

关键数字 生产负载上，ConfluxServe 相比最强基线提升 serving goodput 1.26–1.62×。

为什么值得看 直面服务利用率与效率两难，算子级异构并行思路对推理系统设计有直接借鉴价值。

item.title: Comparative Analysis of Large Load Interconnection Requirements Across U.S. Transmission Entities
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.AR)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

The rapid growth of large loads, especially data centers driven by artificial intelligence, is creating unprecedented demands on the North American electric grid.

The rapid growth of large loads, especially data centers driven by artificial intelligence, is creating unprecedented demands on the North American electric grid. Data centers now account for nearly 80% of large load interconnection requests in the Western Interconnection, and U.S. electricity consumption from data centers is projected to reach 325-580 TWh by 2028. Despite this urgency, technical interconnection requirements for large loads have not yet matured and still contain several gaps. This paper presents a comparative analysis of large load interconnection requirements across eleven U.S. entities, including AEP, Ameren, CAISO, Dominion, Duke Energy, ERCOT, LIPA, MISO, PJM, Southern Company, and SPP, under seven technical categories: large load definition, load data and modeling, fault ride-through, load curtailment and shedding, dispatchability, power quality, and reactive power control. The analysis reveals significant variation in both the scope and specificity of requirements. LIPA addresses all seven technical categories at least partially, while Dominion and Duke Energy provide detailed coverage across nearly all categories. The analysis also finds that data center app…

item.title: Collective Dynamics of Self-Reinforcement: How Cross-Task Coupling Drives Policy Collapse in Unsupervised RLVR
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Label-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rewards a language model for agreeing with its own majority vote.

Label-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rewards a language model for agreeing with its own majority vote. It improves reasoning at first but eventually collapses: the self-assessed reward goes to one while accuracy falls, often until the model gives the same answer to every problem. The collapse appears only when training uses many problems. We explain this dataset-size dependence as a collective instability. In a solvable many-problem model in which problems share parameters, a population whose problems prefer different answers amplifies any shared perturbation for as long as the population-averaged slope $\langle F'\rangle$ of the single-problem self-reinforcement drift $F$ is positive. This holds while problems are still uncertain about their answers. Per-problem sharpening, slowed by $1/N$ for $N$ training problems, races against the shared mode, which grows at a rate $\proptoλ^2$ independent of $N$, where $λ$ is the strength of the shared coupling. This yields a critical number of problems $N_c\simeq\ln(1/δ)/(λ^2G)$, where $δ$ seeds the shared mode and $G$ decreases with the initial confidence. It improves reasoning at first but eventually collapses: the self-assessed reward goes to one while accuracy falls, often until the model gives the same answer to every problem. The collapse appears only when training uses many problems. We explain this dataset-size dependence as a collective instability. In a solvable many-problem model in which problems share parameters, a population whose problems prefer different answers amplifies any shared perturbation for as long as the population-averaged slope $\langle F'\rangle$ of the single-problem self-reinforcement drift $F$ is positive. This holds while problems are still uncertain about their answers. Per-problem sharpening, slowed by $1/N$ for $N$ training problems, races against the shared mode, which grows at a rate $\proptoλ^2$ independent of $N$, where $λ$ is the strength of the shared coupling. This yields a critical number of problems $N_c\simeq\ln(1/δ)/(λ^2G)$, where $δ$ seeds the shared mode and $G$ decreases with the initial confidence. item.title: CaLLM: Continual Adaptation of LLMs via Non-Parametric Adapter Routing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem.

Continual adaptation of large language models (LLMs) to evolving task distributions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting remains an open problem. Existing strategies often struggle to scale or lack a robust mechanism for zero-shot task-to-expert assignment. We introduce CaLLM, a framework that resolves these tensions by combining metric-based meta-learning with modular parameter isolation via lightweight adapters. First, CaLLM projects each input batch into a task-agnostic embedding space to find its nearest prototype. It then routes the batch to the specific adapter specialized for that data distribution. This formulation provides (i)~controllable cross-task interference by design, (ii)~constant computational complexity regardless of task count, (iii)~seamless integration of novel distributions through prototype expansion, and (iv)~regime agnosticism as the local routing decision enables a unified approach to both online and offline settings. Our experiments demonstrate that this routing mechanism discovers semantically coherent task groupings while facilitating constructive interference between similar tasks, and keeping overhead at a minimum. item.title: Bi-Phase Training: Learning Efficiently From Scratch
item.description:
发表方：arXiv(cs.LG)　发布：2026-10-27　分类：论文PDF

Pre-training foundational models is computationally expensive as models scale.

Pre-training foundational models is computationally expensive as models scale. In this work, we introduce Bi-Phase Training (BPT), a parameter-efficient pre-training method that preserves the high-rank learning dynamics observed in full-parameter optimization with substantially reduced trainable parameters. BPT parameterizes each weight update as a composition of constrained high-rank left/right transformations via trainable diagonal matrices and low-rank adapters whose updates are periodically merged into the frozen base weights, resulting in a compounding expansion of accessible directions during training. Across language-model pre-training from scratch (Qwen2.5 models from 100M to 1.5B parameters and OLMo-2-1B) on FineWeb-Edu (10B and 100B tokens), BPT achieves validation perplexity close to full-parameter baselines while using far fewer trainable parameters; e.g., at the 1.5B scale, BPT uses 66% fewer trainable parameters with only a small validation-perplexity gap. Additionally, a comprehensive evaluation across diverse downstream tasks shows that BPT preserves much of the full-parameterized model's downstream performance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。
